raw.description:
Description

The Director of Product owns the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer: the internal applications, automation, and AI that help our staff deliver marketing services, and the direct-to-market products such as LOOP Analytics and future offerings. This role defines how our products work together as one consolidated, scalable system, makes sure each one delivers clear value to the people it was built for, and turns the capability of our development team into products that set OuterBox apart. The Director leads the Product Managers, sets product priorities and standards in partnership with the Director of Technology, holds the team to effective execution, and reports on how well our products perform for the service organization and our clients.

Job Responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Set the Product Vision: Define and own the vision for OuterBox's product technology layer, internal and external. Describe how our systems, applications, and AI work in concert, and keep that vision current as our services, our clients, and the technology change.
  • Own the Product Portfolio & Architecture: Keep the portfolio consolidated and coherent. Decide what we build, combine, retire, or buy so every product has a clear purpose, a defined user, and a place in the larger system. Partner with the Director of Technology so product architecture and technical architecture scale together.
  • Build Products for Our Delivery Teams: Direct the applications that help our staff deliver marketing services faster, more consistently, and more intelligently. Make sure each tool is designed around the people who use it and proves its value in their daily work.
  • Lead Direct-to-Market Products: Own product strategy for client-facing offerings such as LOOP Analytics and the products that follow. Identify market opportunities that grow out of our internal capability, shape them into offerings, and hold products that carry OuterBox's external reputation to the highest standard.
  • Lead the Product Management Team: Lead, coach, and develop the Product Managers. Set the operating cadence and hold a consistent standard of product thinking, user empathy, and design quality.
  • Turn Development Talent into Great Products: Give the development team clear direction, well-defined problems, and build-ready requirements. Own the PRD and acceptance-criteria standards, guide development and testing timelines, and keep the roadmap focused on the work with the most impact.
  • Drive Effective Execution: Direct the intake, feedback, prioritization, pilot, and rollout programs the Product Managers run. Set the criteria that move a product from pilot to production, and make sure what ships is adopted.
  • Measure & Report Product Effectiveness: Define the KPIs for each product and report on how well our products perform for the service organization, our clients, and the business. Translate adoption, usage, delivery improvement, and displaced-software-spend data into clear business impact.
  • Evaluate Emerging Technology: Track developments in AI, automation, and product practice. Run structured trials and recommend adoption or rejection with a clear rationale.
  • Additional duties, as assigned.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product management or product leadership, with 2+ years leading product managers or product teams.
  • A track record of setting product vision and strategy across a portfolio of related products, consolidating overlapping tools into a coherent, scalable platform, and taking new products to market.
  • Experience shipping both internal tools and external, client-facing software products, including AI, automation, and data-driven applications built in partnership with a development team.
  • Data orientation: able to define product KPIs, direct dashboards, and translate usage and adoption data into business impact.
  • Working knowledge of how digital marketing agencies deliver services
  • Fluency in product process, including PRDs and acceptance criteria, prioritization, and pilot and rollout programs, with credible participation in architecture and build decisions alongside technology leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, or equivalent).
  • Strong product design and user-experience judgment, grounded in user research, feedback programs, and adoption measurement (interviews, NPS, surveys).
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, AI-accelerated environment, with working familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) and cloud-native platforms (Google Cloud Platform).

Benefits

Empowering your journey through every stage of growth—so you can do your best work and live your best life.

Boxer Benefits

Exceptional teams deserve exceptional support. Our employee benefits package includes generous paid time off, healthcare coverage, retirement savings options, professional development opportunities, and additional perks designed to help you stay healthy, productive, and fulfilled both at work and at home.

  • Health Insurance
  • 401(k) & Retirement Savings
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Flexible Scheduling
  • Remote-First Culture
  • Professional Development
  • Employee Referral Program
  • And more!

Salary Description: $140,000 - $160,000

Our Company Values

Great results don’t happen by chance. They come from talented people working together with shared expectations, mutual respect, and a commitment to doing what’s right.

At OuterBox, our values guide how we approach our work, support our teammates, and serve our clients. They influence the decisions we make every day and help create a culture where people can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow throughout their careers.

Growth At OuterBox

We believe growth is oxygen—for our clients, our company, and our people. That’s why we’re committed to helping every teammate reach their next stage of growth.

Every person joins OuterBox with different experiences, ambitions, and career goals. We believe great leaders meet people where they are, providing the support, resources, and opportunities needed to grow professionally, develop new skills, and build a rewarding career.

Whether you’re looking to deepen your expertise, take on new challenges, or grow into leadership, you’ll find a team invested in helping you get there.

﻿Physical Demands

  • Primarily involves sitting at a desk and using a computer for extended periods of time.
  • Light physical activity is also required, such as carrying equipment or setting up for presentations.
  • Requires a high level of mental focus and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Good manual dexterity, hand-eye coordination, and the ability to use a computer for extended periods are required.

Utilizes required organization-provided tools, such as project management systems, artificial intelligence (AI) applications, reporting and analytics programs, and other business software, as directed by management in the regular course of business. Use of such tools ensures accuracy, accountability, and continuity across projects, supports collaboration among team members, and allows the organization to maintain visibility into work product and progress.

Work Authorization/Requirements

Must be located in the USA.

We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Affirmative Action/EEO Statement

Our company is an equal-opportunity employer committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

OuterBox may use AI-assisted tools to support the hiring process. Human review is involved in all employment decisions.

About Us: Prometric is a leading provider of technology-enabled testing and assessment solutions to many of the world’s most recognized licensing and certification organizations, academic institutions, and government agencies. We support more than 7 million test takers annually at our testing locations in 180 countries around the world. With over three decades of experience working with clients of all sizes across a multitude of industry sectors, our mission is to design and deliver the highest quality and most innovative testing solutions anytime, anywhere.

JOB TITLE: Business Development Manager REPORTS TO: VP, Account Management DEPARTMEN: Account Management LOCATION: Remote in U.S

Job Overview:

Prometric is seeking a high-performing Business Development Manager to expand our presence across multiple industries by introducing organizations to our market-leading assessment and credentialing solutions. As demand continues to grow for secure, flexible, and location-agnostic testing experiences, this role will be instrumental in identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities.

Working from both marketing-generated leads and self-sourced prospects, you will engage senior decision-makers, uncover business challenges, and position Prometric's solutions to deliver value, improve access, strengthen test security, and support workforce and credentialing objectives. Success in this role requires a consultative sales mindset, strong prospecting skills, and the ability to translate customer needs into compelling business outcomes.

COMPANY BACKGROUND

Prometric (www.prometric.com) is a trusted test development and delivery provider to more than 300 organizations worldwide. Prometric serves as an industry gatekeeper, ensuring that people legitimately earn the credentials they seek to achieve, and thereby guaranteeing a fair testing experience for all who come through our doors.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive new business growth by identifying, pursuing, and closing opportunities across Prometric's target markets and industry verticals.
  • Lead complex sales engagements from prospecting through contract execution, including competitive pursuits, executive presentations, and commercial negotiations.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer strategies, challenges, and business objectives to position high-value assessment and credentialing solutions.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior decision-makers, influencers, and strategic partners serving as strategic advisors throughout the sales process.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Technology, Finance, Legal, and Executive Leadership, to develop customer centric solutions and winning proposals.
  • Execute consultative sales strategies that align customer needs with Prometric's assessment, testing, and credentialing capabilities.
  • Build, manage, and maintain a robust sales pipeline while delivering accurate forecasts and revenue projections.
  • Represent Prometric at industry conferences, trade shows, and customer engagements to enhance market presence and generate new business opportunities.
  • Monitor industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activity to identify emerging opportunities and inform commercial strategy.
  • Utilize Salesforce and other sales tools to effectively manage opportunities, customer engagement, and pipeline performance.
  • Lead commercial discussions and contract negotiations to secure profitable, long-term customer relationships.
  • Successfully navigate complex buying cycles, differentiate Prometric's value proposition, and advance opportunities through the sales process.
  • Achieve or exceed annual bookings, revenue targets, and pipeline objectives while maintaining a high level of professionalism and customer satisfaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of successful consultative, solution-based sales experience with a demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles and strategic customer relationships.
  • Proven track record of selling to C-level executives and senior decision-makers within medium to large organizations.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced business, technology, or related professional certifications are preferred.
  • Demonstrated success generating new business, penetrating new markets, and consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Experience leading competitive sales pursuits, including RFP responses, executive presentations, and multi-stakeholder evaluation processes.
  • Proven ability to identify, develop, negotiate, and close enterprise-level opportunities in highly competitive markets.
  • Experience selling technology, SaaS, assessment, credentialing, education, workforce development, or other business-to-business solutions.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience developing proposals, pricing strategies, business cases, and return-on-investment justifications.
  • Ability to negotiate complex agreements involving procurement, legal, financial, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to understand customer challenges and develop tailored, value-driven solutions.
  • Self-starter with a results-oriented mindset and a history of achieving ambitious sales, pipeline, and growth objectives.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to build credibility and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels, including senior leadership and executive teams.
  • Demonstrated success working cross-functionally with product, operations, technology, finance, legal, and leadership teams to develop and deliver winning solutions.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously while maintaining a customer-first focus.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce CRM and other sales enablement tools for pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity tracking.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 35% to support customer meetings, industry events, conferences, and business development activities.

Prometric is an Equal Employment/Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate in hiring based on sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, and local law.

The role. We're bringing growth in-house. You'll replace our paid-ads agency and own customer acquisition and retention end to end, reporting to the CEO. Your work will move sales visibly, and you'll help build our AI creative workflows from the ground up.

You'll stand out if you: have beauty, skincare, fragrance or gifting experience; edit short-form video; build automations with Claude, n8n or Make.

Hours: at least 4 hours overlap with 9am–5pm US Pacific.

Application questions:

  1. Upload a Meta Ads Manager screenshot of campaigns you ran (spend, purchases, ROAS visible).

  2. Upload a screenshot of a Klaviyo flow you built, with its revenue or conversion stats.

raw.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S.

The Medical Bill Review Specialist serves as a primary liaison between clients, Service Operations, and internal business partners to support the delivery of Workers' Compensation medical bill review services. This position is responsible for maintaining client relationships, supporting operational performance, implementing program enhancements, resolving service issues, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction.

The successful candidate will possess strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to leverage technology and AI-enabled tools to improve service delivery, reporting, and operational efficiency.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary operational contact for assigned clients, building and maintaining strong working relationships.
  • Coordinate client program changes and support implementation activities to ensure seamless service delivery.
  • Monitor operational performance, including inventory, turnaround times, and service-level commitments, and address issues as appropriate.
  • Investigate and resolve client inquiries, service concerns, and operational escalations.
  • Collaborate with clients, vendors, and internal business partners to resolve workflow challenges and support business objectives.
  • Prepare, analyze, and present operational reports, performance metrics, and business insights to stakeholders.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, service quality, and the client experience.
  • Maintain workflow documentation, procedures, and operational best practices.
  • Utilize Microsoft Copilot and other AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, reporting, analysis, communication, and workflow effectiveness.
  • Participate in client meetings, business reviews, audits, and special projects as assigned.
  • Business travel as needed.

Successful candidates will demonstrate the ability to:

  • Build credibility and strong partnerships with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Balance client expectations with operational priorities while maintaining a high level of service.
  • Use data, technology, and sound judgment to support informed decision-making.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Anticipate challenges, identify practical solutions, and execute with minimal supervision.
  • Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, service quality, and client satisfaction.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma and two or more years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong customer service, communication, and relationship management skills.
  • Demonstrated analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Ability to effectively utilize Microsoft Copilot and other AI-enabled productivity tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Workers' Compensation medical bill review.
  • Knowledge of Workers' Compensation regulations and processes.
  • Experience supporting clients in Texas, California, Utah, Florida, Pennsylvania, Nevada, New York, and Illinois.
  • Experience with Salesforce, SmartAdvisor, Tableau, or similar reporting and workflow management tools.
  • Experience with operational reporting, data analysis, and process improvement initiatives.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $59,000 - $75,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

raw.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this role, you will help train and refine Grok's voice and language capabilities in Oromo. Your expertise will directly shape how Grok speaks and understands Oromo, from pronunciation and natural phrasing to cultural nuance. You will see your work show up in a product used by people around the world.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Annotate, label, and provide feedback on multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, and speech samples using proprietary tools.
  • Translate and localize text (UI copy, prompts, responses, and other content) from English into Oromo, with attention to accuracy, natural phrasing, and cultural fit.
  • Help produce clear, natural audio data that accurately captures linguistic and prosodic details such as intonation, rhythm, and accent.
  • Collaborate with technical staff to refine annotation guidelines and tools for handling accents, background noise, speech variation, and multilingual audio.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proficiency in Oromo at CEFR C1 level or higher.
  • English proficiency at CEFR B2 level or higher.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Native proficiency in Oromo.
  • English proficiency at CEFR C1 level or higher.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Advanced transcription or audio annotation, with strong attention to accents, prosody, disfluencies, and variable recording quality.
    • Translation or localization work (especially UI, product copy, or conversational text) between English and Oromo.
    • Voice recording, voice acting, podcasting, or related audio production that demonstrates clear delivery and attention to sound quality.
    • Background in linguistics, phonetics, speech sciences, or hands-on work with speech/audio datasets and AI training data.

LOCATION AND OTHER EXPECTATIONS:

  • This is a remote role which may be performed from the following countries:
    • United States
    • United Kingdom
    • Canada
    • Australia
  • This role may be offered as a full-time or part-time position, depending on role / business needs and candidate availability. Full-time positions are preferred and require working standard business hours in your local time zone.
  • Positions are typically offered as fixed-term employment contracts of 6 months. Extensions or conversion to a permanent role may be available based on business needs.
  • For US-based candidates, please note that we are unable to hire in Wyoming and Illinois at this time.
  • We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.
  • Travel to a SpaceXSI site may be required.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

US-based candidates: $35/hour - $45/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.

Benefits vary based on employment type, location, and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible US-based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role-specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

Our job is to remove other teams' bottlenecks: we build and run core internal services that power large geo-distributed infrastructure, and a growing share of what we ship is driven by AI agents. As an intern, you will work alongside senior engineers to design, build, and ship production systems – from backend services that run automated workflows at massive scale to AI agents that take routine work off engineers' plates. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience with agentic AI and modern infrastructure while contributing to real products used by teams across NVIDIA.


What you'll be doing:

  • Work with senior engineers to design, build, and improve backend services and APIs for internal platforms that run automated workflows at massive scale
  • Build AI agents and agentic workflows that connect LLMs to tools and internal services, and integrate them into production systems
  • Help make agents reliable and safe in production – from access control and guardrails to evaluating agent quality
  • Assist in building data pipelines and GPU job orchestration for synthetic data generation and model evaluation at scale
  • Implement and improve observability (tracing, metrics, logging) for distributed services and agents
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging, and apply software engineering best practices in a production environment
  • Work in a product-minded way: talk to internal users, prototype quickly, collect feedback, and iterate

What we need to see:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Strong programming fundamentals in at least one of: Go (preferred), Python, or C#
  • Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms
  • Basic knowledge of software design patterns and API design concepts
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs – for example, a project, prototype, or coursework that uses LLM APIs
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git)
  • Understanding of database concepts and SQL
  • Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn new technologies
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience building AI agents or LLM-powered applications: tool/function calling, MCP, RAG, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit)
  • Experience with distributed systems concepts (REST APIs, microservices architecture) and containerization (Docker)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), GPU workloads, and infrastructure automation
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana), and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes)
  • Experience with database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch)

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the most desirable employers in the world. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you. raw.excerpt: About the Role PURE Risk Managers perform independent risk assessments to evaluate complex property exposures and support underwriting and loss prevention strategies for our members who are owners of the finest built homes.
raw.description:
About the Role


PURE Risk Managers perform independent risk assessments to evaluate complex property exposures and support underwriting and loss prevention strategies for our members who are owners of the finest built homes. Risk Managers apply professional judgment, technical expertise, and discretion to assess risk and determine replacement cost.


Risk Managers work with a high degree of autonomy, interfacing directly with our members to communicate findings on underlying risk factors identified in their homes, recommending mitigation solutions that impact business operations, underwriting decisions, and loss exposure.


This remote position requires extensive travel throughout the Western United States to conduct in-home risk assessments. The ideal candidate will be based in a location with convenient access to a major airport. Preferred locations include Las Vegas, NV; Phoenix, AZ; Bozeman, MT; Boise, ID; and Reno, NV.


Depending on the candidate’s location, 70%-100% of the homes they will see may be located outside of their home state.


What You'll Do


  • Perform PURE 360 Risk assessments by evaluating complex and varied property conditions across regions, construction types, and environmental factors, assessing risk exposure.
  • Analyze and interpret findings to assess loss probability and severity, using professional judgment to determine appropriate recommendations.
  • Recommend loss prevention strategies by identifying practical solutions and prioritizing actions based on risk impact.
  • Using professional judgment, technical expertise, and discretion, this role assesses property conditions, evaluates replacement cost considerations, identifies material risk factors, and determines the significance of exposures that may affect underwriting decisions, loss potential, and business operations.
  • Partner with Underwriting and internal stakeholders to provide insight that supports risk selection and business decisions.
  • Evaluate unique site conditions and risk factors by applying technical knowledge and experience to geographic and peril-specific scenarios.
  • Operate independently in the field with flexibility in approach and execution, adapting methods based on property-specific conditions.
  • Travel regularly throughout the Western United States to conduct in-home assessments and engage directly with members.
  • Communicate assessment results and recommendations clearly, including the rationale behind decisions and potential risk implications.
  • Serve as a trusted representative of the PURE brand in members’ homes, building credibility through thoughtful, knowledgeable engagement while bringing humility, professionalism, and genuine care to every interaction – delivering a service experience that reflects our commitment to excellence.

What You'll Need


  • Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required – relevant field experience is highly valued
  • 3+ years of experience as a Risk Manager at an insurance carrier, or in a related insurance role with exposure to property risk assessment and broader risk management practices
  • OR 5+ years of experience in high-value home construction, skilled trades (e.g., plumbing, electrical, HVAC), home inspection, appraisal, or a related field
  • Strong interpersonal and oral and written communication skills are a must
  • Demonstrated ability to apply independent judgment and discretion in complex situations
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
  • Professional, trustworthy and passionate about helping others
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively throughout the Western United States.

The base salary for this role can range from $80k-100k, based on a full-time work schedule. An individual’s ultimate compensation will vary depending on job-related skills and experience, geographic location, alignment with market data, and equity among other team members with comparable experience.

‌

What We Do

We're a member-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. We provide exceptional service, hospitality and care, we partner with our members to help prevent losses and we create smart insurance solutions at fair prices.

We aim for our members to love their insurance. It is our mission is to create a membership experience so compelling that ​our members never want to leave.

Who We Are

We want to be transparent about what we expect from each other. From PURE, you can expect:


Opportunities to stretch and grow: your professional and personal development matters to us. We’re committed to providing experiences through on-the-job learning and professional development that increase your impact and rewards.


Clarity and kindness: you can rely on us to be open, honest and supportive, offering clarity on what success looks like.


Support in good times and bad: we believe in showing up for each other consistently, not only when it’s easy. You can expect a thoughtful partner, even when we disagree.


A community that cares: we are committed to sustaining a community in which each person feels cared for as an individual. We lift each other up, celebrate wins together and support one another through challenges in work and life.

Who You Are

All of the strongest relationships are a partnership- a two way street. So here’s what we ask of you:

  • Aim to bring your best every day: you’re here because you want to be part of a team that makes a real impact and aims high.
  • Be a student and a teacher: share your knowledge and talents and be willing to listen and learn from those around you.
  • Get comfortable being uncomfortable: we face tough moments and obstacles with a “courage over comfort” approach and a positive, solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Be a culture builder: building a positive culture is everyone's responsibility, based on care, respect and openness to diverse perspectives.

Job Description Summary

The Strategic National Vendor Operations Specialist supports the execution and administration of customer service contracts for assigned national vendor operations. This role manages contract loading, installed base data accuracy, billing support, contract administration, and cross-functional issue resolution. Key responsibilities include maintaining accurate corrective and planned maintenance records, coordinating vendor services, and supporting timely case closure. The position partners closely with Service Sales, Field Service, internal operations teams, and customers to ensure contracts are entered accurately, billing is completed on time, and customer commitments are met. This operational role focuses on vendors at national level and individual customer support.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

Execute and manage customer service contract transactions, including additions, deletions, modifications, verification, and submission prework.

  • Support billing accuracy and timely contract-to-billing handoffs for contract, non-contract, ODS, and vendor-related services.
  • Maintain installed base and contract data integrity through audits, updates, corrections, and coordination with field teams and customers.
  • Maintain customer and vendor equipment modifications at the local and national levels while supporting installed base accuracy.
  • Oversee key operational workflows, including transaction schedules, inactive CMODs, capping defects, warranty conversions, new equipment warranty audits, and open PO reporting.
  • Align with expanded Vendor Operations and Contract Management team workflows to improve efficiency.
  • Coordinate vendor service activities, including service requests, corrective repair, and planned maintenance follow-up, closure, scheduling, OCA management, and local or national vendor contract processes.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Service Sales, Field Service, Service Marketing, Commercial Solutions, ASL reviewers, and other stakeholders to resolve billing, contract, process, and data issues.
  • Monitor system activity, reporting, and work queues to support service commitments, issue resolution, and operational visibility.
  • Identify and support process improvements, standard work, and quality controls to improve consistency, compliance, and customer experience.
  • Complete required Quality and Compliance responsibilities, training, reporting, and corrective actions in accordance with GE HealthCare policies and applicable requirements.
  • Coordinate vendor on-site support for planned maintenance and corrective maintenance activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related discipline and at least one year of customer service experience; or high school diploma/GED and five or more years of customer service experience.
  • High proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Word, Outlook, Excel, and Access.
  • Minimum of two years of experience working with Microsoft Excel.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in the local language.
  • Strong customer focus with a demonstrated commitment to customer satisfaction.
  • Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines and commitments.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience supporting service contracts, order management, billing, installed base data, or contract administration in a healthcare, technology, or field service environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify data inconsistencies, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions and communicate clearly with internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Comfort working in multiple systems and adapting to evolving tools, processes, and business requirements.

Overview

The Opportunity – Why Join

Are you ready to redefine how an entire industry engages with customers? At AAA Life we leverage technology to put human connection at the heart of what we do. If you are someone who thrives on purpose and wants to make a tangible difference in people’s lives when it matters most, then join AAA Life who has the unique ability to access tens of millions of existing AAA customers powered by the strength of one of America’s most trusted brands. We have embarked on a mission to double in size - Becoming one of the largest providers in the US. These facts showcase why we're the right choice:

  • On purpose: a leading professional services firm found that the commitment, empathy and dedication of employees at AAA Life was the highest across a benchmark of top US companies
  • On growth: we have the privilege to offer our products to tens of millions of Americans that are proud members of AAA
  • On making a difference: we serve Americans by delivering life insurance products that make a true difference for families during their hardest times, not wealth management instruments (more details on this during the interview)
  • On culture: USA Today named us 2025 top workplace nationwide. We believe the job of an insurance company is to do good. Our mission is to help our members during what is often the hardest times in their lives. We pick up the phone to people who have lost loved ones and offer our genuine support. That is why we will always put human connection at the heart of what we do - always being there to talk to our members person to person. We believe the job of an insurance company is to pay out. That is what insurance is for. Most of our members have real life policies - policies that bring peace of mind during life, and genuine support in the event of death. We are not here to chase the super-rich with annuities and wealth management products. AAA has been one of the most trusted names in America because it believes in providing the services that middle class Americans need.

At AAA Life, we’re dedicated to providing quality life insurance and annuity products with the care and service our members expect. As we continue to modernize and innovate, our Technology team plays a vital role in delivering secure, efficient, and member-first solutions. We are seeking an experienced SDET to help strengthen our QA automation capabilities and support our CI/CD efforts.

As a Software Development Engineer in Test at AAA Life, you will design, develop, and maintain automated tests and shared test infrastructure using Playwright and TypeScript to validate functionality, stability, and release readiness across our technology ecosystem. You'll be a hands-on engineer who partners closely with product owners, engineers, and QA analysts to ensure product quality and support seamless CI/CD using GitLab.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automated UI and API tests using Playwright and TypeScript across application repositories and shared automation libraries.
  • Build and maintain smoke, regression, and integration coverage using Playwright tagging and test selection patterns.
  • Create and maintain automated tests that run reliably in GitLab CI/CD pipelines on merge requests and scheduled runs.
  • Collaborate with product owners, engineers, and QA analysts to define testing strategies, clarify acceptance criteria, and support shift-left testing.
  • Investigate test failures, distinguish test issues from product defects, and report clear, reproducible defects with evidence.
  • Participate in code reviews for test code and follow team standards for readability, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Help upskill manual QA teammates through pairing, review feedback, and practical guidance on Playwright and TypeScript automation patterns.
  • Contribute to performance and load testing initiatives when needed.
  • Advocate for testability, automation best practices, and continuous improvement aligned with DevOps and Agile delivery.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 4+ years of experience in test automation or software development in test.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript for test automation.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining UI and API automated tests.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD and integrating automated tests into pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of testing strategies for UI, API, integration, and regression.
  • Experience with SQL or data validation across UI, API, and backend layers.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and shift-left testing practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in the insurance or financial services industry.
  • Exposure to containerization technologies such as Docker and testing in lower environments.
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or Gatling.
  • Knowledge of security testing practices.
  • Experience mentoring, pairing with, or coaching teammates on test automation.
  • Familiarity with contract testing or validating API behavior against OpenAPI or schema definitions.

How You’ll Work

  • Work Solution: Hybrid (Tuesday- Thursday) or Remote (USA)

What We Bring to the Table

  • Hybrid work environment that promotes work-life balance
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage starting from your first day
  • Employer 401k match and employer contribution to a pension plan
  • Generous PTO and paid parental leave to support your family needs
  • Various associate resource groups and community involvement initiatives

Essential Job Functions 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. 

 

This job requires the ability to perform duties contained in the job description for this position, including, but not limited to, the above requirements.  Reasonable accommodation will be provided for otherwise qualified applicants as needed to enable them to fulfill these requirements. 

 

AAA Life Insurance Company does not offer immigration sponsorship for this position. This includes visa types such as H-1B, TN, and STEM OPT. Please do not apply if you currently require or may require employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.

Sr. Manager of Claims

Remote

Company Overview: AMSURG is an independent leader in ambulatory surgery center services, operating a network of more than 250 surgery centers nationwide. In partnership with physicians and health systems, the organization delivers high-quality care for patients across a diverse spectrum of medical specialties, including gastroenterology, ophthalmology and orthopedics. To learn more about AMSURG, visit www.amsurg.com.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Sr. Manager of Claims provides strategic leadership, operational oversight, and hands-on management for AMSURG’s comprehensive claims portfolio. This role manages the end-to-end claims lifecycle within the Risk Management department, directly impacting the organization’s financial and operational resilience. The ideal candidate is analytical, driven, and someone who can manage a diverse portfolio consisting of Workers’ Compensation (40%), Property (40%), General Liability (10%), and Professional Liability (10%). They will own the process from initial incident evaluation and carrier notification through to final resolution and litigation management, collaborating closely with executive leadership, internal teams, and external partners.

Work Schedule: Remote-First

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Claim Ownership & Strategy: Owns the evaluation and investigation of all reported incidents, allegations or claims in the AMSURG system; independently assesses liability, determines compensability, verifies coverages, and manager carrier notifications.
  • Litigation & Partner Management: Partners directly with external insurance adjusters and defense counsel to drive aggressive defense strategies, optimize claim outcomes, and execute releases or payments within designated authority.
  • Operational Excellence: Lifts the strategic vision for the claims function, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, high performance, and compliance.
  • Cross-Functional Advisory: Serves as a subject matter expert for Corporate and Center staff on claims-related issues, including optimizing Return-to-Work programs and managing subpoenas and medical record requests.
  • Data & Financial Intelligence: Analyzes complex claims data and third-party loss runs to identify risk trends; translates data into actionable strategic insights and prepares ad-hoc reporting for leadership.
  • Collaboration: Collaborates seamlessly with Finance, Legal, IT, Real Estate, and Operations to integrate risk management best practices across the organization.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required.

  • Basic knowledge of claims processes is required to handle matters (both litigated and non-litigated).
  • Understanding of reserve setting, claim finances, and loss run data analytics.
  • Strong knowledge of state or federal regulations and/or statutes regarding insured claims preferred.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with a minimum of eight (8) years’ experience as a claims handler required. Professional Liability, Workers Compensation, and Property experience highly preferred.

Employment at AMSURG:Living Our Values Every Day
At AMSURG, our values define who we are and how we serve our patients, partners, and each other. As a national leader in ambulatory surgery, we are committed to a culture of excellence, integrity, teamwork and caring deeply. Our values guide every decision, ensuring we continue to elevate healthcare and provide the highest quality care.
These guiding principles are the foundation of our culture and a guide to how we collaborate, innovate, and make a difference every day.

  • Care Deeply for those around us.
  • Cultivate Integrity to build trust.
  • Champion Excellence for continuous improvement
  • Celebrate Teamwork every step to the way.

Benefits:

To ensure we retain and invest in great people, AMSURG provides its employees with the benefits, recognition, training, and opportunities needed for professional growth. Our wide range of health and welfare benefits allow you to choose the right coverage for you and your family. AMSURG offers a variety of health and welfare benefit options to help protect your health and promote your wellbeing. raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontier: AI Products. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from AI-driven automation.

About the Team:

This specialist team reports into a Sales Director (SD) and consists of specialist sellers aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of a new product and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to 1 or more regional directors for mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You are an AI pragmatist: You understand that AI Products are about outcomes, not just "cool tech." You can translate LLM and agentic capabilities into tangible safety and efficiency gains for the physical world.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara’s AI Products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-develop new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high potential “AI-ready” accounts
  • Drive high-touch pilot strategy and success metrics for early adoption
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org

.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • 2+ years of direct experience selling in AI-based commercial models (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Twilio, or AI-native platforms).
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with $500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling "Version 1.0" products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • 4+ years direct experience selling AI-based commercial models with a deep understanding of forecasting and expansion mechanics.
  • Strong grasp of AI/ML concepts and how AI Products differ from standard automation.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) for full-time employees for this position is below. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$350,000—$350,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for driving new business and expansion revenue across NinjaOne’s largest enterprise accounts and prospects. You will be responsible for expanding NinjaOne adoption within Global 2000 prospects by aligning NinjaOne’s platform and solutions to complex IT operational challenges. You will also identify and close cross-sell and upsell opportunities within the existing customer base. This role owns the full sales cycle and requires a strong combination of prospecting, territory planning, relationship development, pipeline management, discovery, presentation delivery, negotiation, and closing skills.

Location: Remote in Illinois.

Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on NinjaOne’s platform and solutions, leading discovery calls, presentations, and product demonstrations with prospective customers.

  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close.

  • Identify key decision-makers, executive stakeholders, buying committees, and procurement processes to advance opportunities and drive successful outcomes.

Job Title:

Account Manager

About Trellix 
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at .

Role Overview:

The Account Manager will be responsible for managing all accounts in the mulicountry territory. They are required to lead their cross-functional team (Sales Engineering, Channel, Inside Sales, CSM, and Renewals) to efficiently close deals and meet their quota in their designated territory.

About the Role:


The Account Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth and managing strategic customer relationships across the assigned Central America and the Caribbean (CCA) territory. This role focuses on expanding within existing customers, acquiring new accounts, and positioning Trellix as a trusted cybersecurity partner across the region.


The Account Manager will develop and execute territory and account strategies, manage complex sales cycles, and collaborate closely with channel partners, technical resources, and internal stakeholders to achieve business objectives. This role requires strong ownership of territory performance, executive engagement capabilities, and the ability to operate independently in a dynamic regional environment.


Given the shared nature of technical resources, the Account Manager is expected to demonstrate solid foundational knowledge of cybersecurity concepts and the ability to lead initial technical discussions with customers while coordinating deeper engagement with Sales Engineering when required.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Achieve and exceed assigned revenue targets across the territory.
  • Develop and execute territory and account plans to drive growth within existing customers and new prospects.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders, including security leaders, IT executives, and business decision makers.
  • Manage complex sales cycles from opportunity identification through negotiation and closure.
  • Lead initial discovery conversations, understanding customer business and technical challenges.
  • Position Trellix solutions by articulating business value and high-level technical capabilities.
  • Collaborate with channel partners to develop opportunities, execute go-to-market initiatives, and accelerate deal progression.
  • Coordinate internal resources, including Sales Engineering and Professional Services, to support customer engagement and opportunity advancement.
  • Drive expansion opportunities within the installed base through cross-sell and upsell strategies.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting discipline in CRM systems.
  • Monitor competitive landscape and market trends to effectively position Trellix solutions.

  • Operate with a high level of ownership, accountability, and autonomy within the assigned territory.

  • Territory Coverage: Panama, Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, and the English-speaking Caribbean (e.g., Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago, Cayman Islands).

Travel may be required to support customer and partner engagement.


About You:


  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in enterprise or commercial technology sales environments.
  • Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of cybersecurity or enterprise IT concepts, with the ability to discuss technical topics with customer stakeholders.
  • Ability to understand and articulate solution architectures at a high level.
  • Strong relationship-building and executive communication skills.
  • Experience working with channel partners and indirect sales models.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to articulate value propositions aligned to customer outcomes.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent organizational, forecasting, and pipeline management skills.
  • Experience using CRM tools and structured sales methodologies.

Company Benefits and Perks:

We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

  • Retirement Plans

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage

  • Paid Time Off

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Support for Community Involvement

We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

Our Commitment to You:

At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.

Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process.

Trellix also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Trellix will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.

Job Description

JOB TITLE

Systems Analyst

LEVEL/BAND

Project

DEPARTMENT

Technology

DIRECT REPORT (JOB TITLE)

​Scrum Master

Overall Purpose of the Position

The role of the IT Systems Analyst is to convert the business requirements into technical specifications and deliverables and determines how the functionality is to be achieved and implemented.

Operational Responsibilities

  • To carry out all assigned tasks efficiently and effectively, in adherence with internal policies and procedures.
  • To participate in the design and implementation of process improvements for the team.
  • To participate in periodic system reviews to identify possible gaps and process inconsistencies and propose re-alignment strategies including the necessary training programmes..

Analytical Responsibilities

  • To liaise with the business analyst/s and/or client/s to ensure compliance with business requirements and agreed specifications.
  • Design technical solution to achieve business objectives and document all work in accordance with agreed standards.
  • Validate and further develop functional requirements into technical requirements/specifications.
  • Derive non-functional requirements from a technical perspective (server uptime, bandwidth, network, etc).
  • Derive technical requirements/specifications.
  • Conduct technical impact assessment & determine dependencies (systems, architecture, data architecture, infrastructure, IT security perspective).
  • Preparing cost benefits and analysis reports for upgrades.

Parameterisation

  • To participate in the implementation of the system by handling the required system parameterisation and other implementation tasks.
  • To assist in Second line support to end-users by handling IT-related incidents or service requests that are related to parameterisation in adherence with incident and service request fulfilment policies and procedures.
  • To ensure that all incidents and service requests assigned to him/her that are related to parameterisation are handled promptly and effectively within agreed service levels.
  • To participate in post implementation reviews to fine tune parameterisation and assess potential for improvements.

General Responsibilities

  • To build relationships and liaise with various stakeholders across the business to ensure cohesion and drive a collaborative work environment.
  • To actively participate in the definition of an IT Governance framework and compliance.
  • To provide recommendations for prioritization of IT initiatives based on understanding of business needs, IT Systems Analysis workload, Application Architecture and budget.
  • To perform any duties that may be assigned to him/her from line management from time to time.
  • Keeps abreast of new and emerging technologies.

Qualifications, Skills & Competencies

Mandatory

Skill

  • Knowledge of Information Systems Analysis and Software Development.
  • Knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle
  • Analysis and Design using UML
  • Customer Driven with an ability to prioritise issues based on impact.
  • Excellent critical analysis and creative skills.

Experience

  • Experience of working under pressure and to tight deadlines.

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or other related field.

Desirable

Skill

  • Enthusiasm for research, problem solving and learning new skills.
  • Good presentation skills.
  • Ability to tackle simultaneous tasks.
  • Knowledge of SQL

Experience

  • Proven experience in eliciting requirements and testing.

Qualification

  • Certified Computing Professional (CCP)
  • Certified Analytics Professional (CAP)

raw.description:
The Opportunity: Join TopDog Law and Build Something Meaningful

This role is an opportunity to:

  • Join a rapidly growing national firm at a formative stage
  • Make a visible, measurable impact on a rapidly growing business
  • Grow your skills, responsibility, and influence as the firm scales
  • Work alongside high-caliber, mission-driven teammates who care deeply about doing great work

We are looking for people who don’t just want a job, they want purpose and impact.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Case Evaluation: Review and assess the merits of clients’ Personal Injury claims by analyzing records, documents, and evidence to determine liability and potential value
  • Legal Representation: Represent clients in Personal Injury matters, including filing claims, gathering evidence, representing a client’s legal position to the adverse insurer, preparing demand letters, negotiating potential settlements, and advocating for clients
  • Legal Strategy: Develop and implement effective strategies to protect clients’ rights and interests. Conduct legal research, analyze medical records, gather evidence, and negotiate with insurance companies to achieve favorable settlements
  • Client Communication: Maintain consistent communication with clients, providing updates, explaining legal processes, and advising them on their rights and options
  • Medical and Vocational Assessment: Collaborate with medical and vocational experts to evaluate the extent of injuries, their impact on clients’ ability to work, and appropriate future treatment requirements
  • Case Management: Organize and maintain case files, track deadlines, coordinate with medical providers and experts, and oversee related legal and administrative tasks
  • Ethical Standards: Uphold professional ethics, confidentiality, and compliance with all applicable rules and regulations

At TopDog Law, everyone is expected to think critically, communicate clearly, and take ownership of their work.

How This Role Drives the Business

This role is critical to our success because it:

  • Maximizes case value through strong case development, sound evaluation, and effective negotiation prior to litigation
  • Moves cases efficiently through the pre-litigation lifecycle, supporting faster resolutions and improved cash flow
  • Identifies cases that should be escalated to litigation early, enabling better strategy, resource allocation, and outcomes
  • Enhances client satisfaction and trust through proactive communication and consistent follow-through
  • Reduces risk and rework by spotting issues early, making decisive recommendations, and ensuring alignment across teams
  • Supports scale by holding case managers accountable to performance metrics and ensuring consistent, high-quality work product
  • Strengthens operational efficiency by reinforcing clear workflows between case managers and the medical records team to avoid delays in case development

Your ability to balance speed, strategy, and quality ensures clients are well-served, teams stay aligned, and the firm continues its rapid, disciplined growth.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6–12 months, success in this role looks like:

  • You independently manage a robust pre-litigation caseload, moving matters efficiently from intake through resolution while maintaining high quality and attention to detail
  • You consistently maximize case value through strong case evaluation, strategic guidance, and effective negotiation
  • You identify cases that require escalation to litigation and make timely, well-reasoned recommendations to ensure optimal outcomes
  • You collaborate closely with case managers, holding them accountable to performance metrics by setting clear expectations, reviewing work product, and ensuring deadlines are met
  • You take ownership of outcomes by maintaining the same level of accountability you expect from your case managers
  • You review, refine, and approve demand packages prepared by case managers, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and strong positioning for negotiation
  • You ensure case managers are effectively coordinating with the medical records team to obtain all necessary records and bills in a timely manner
  • You maintain proactive, consistent communication with clients, ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout the process
  • You identify issues early, make timely recommendations, and help prevent bottlenecks
  • You build strong cases that, if needed, can be taken into litigation and through trial

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school
  • Active admission to the Georgia Bar
  • 5 - 10 years of experience in Personal Injury law
  • Strong communication, negotiation, research, and writing skills
  • Ability to manage a robust case load independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of Georgia laws, regulations, and procedures required
  • Must be located in or near the State of Georgia
  • Strong communication skills—written and verbal
  • Ability to think critically, prioritize effectively, and execute with speed

Nice to Have:

  • Active Admission to one or more districts of the Georgia Federal Court
  • Experience in a fast-growing or high-volume environment
  • Comfort with ambiguity and evolving systems
  • Experience in legal, professional services, or client-centric organizations

About TopDog Law

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling, fully integrated, personal injury law firm with strong partner relationships across the country. We are building for impact, excellence, and growth.
We are building a high-performance, high-trust, no-ego culture where talented people do meaningful work, grow quickly, and take pride in what they build together. This is not a legacy law firm.

This is a rocket ship, and we’re assembling the team that will take it to the next level.
If you thrive in fast-moving environments, love taking ownership and being held accountable, and want to be part of something you can help shape, not just maintain, you’ll feel right at home here.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we’ve grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what’s possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now, we’re applying that same discipline and innovation to law firm operations, case management, and execution as we scale nationally and fully integrate.

We are intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams needed to scale at a national level—without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability. This is still the early stage of that journey, which means the people who join now have a real opportunity to help shape how the firm operates for years to come.

Who Thrives Here

We don’t hire based on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

You will thrive at TopDog Law if you:

Embrace Change

  • You have a growth mindset and seek continuous improvement
  • You welcome feedback and adapt quickly
  • You ask “What’s next?” rather than “That’s not my job”

Are Committed to the Organization

  • You care deeply about doing great work
  • You have your teammates’ backs
  • You’re here to build something meaningful and long-lasting

Bring an Upbeat, No-Ego Energy

  • You show up positive, professional, and solutions-oriented
  • You enjoy the work and respect the people around you
  • You leave drama, negativity, and ego at the door

Take Ownership

  • You do what you say you’ll do
  • You follow through and communicate early when something’s off track
  • You treat the business like it’s yours

Fast & Hungry

  • You move with urgency and sound judgment
  • You prioritize progress over perfection
  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-expectation environments
  • You seek feedback, stretch assignments, and more responsibility
  • You’re motivated by growth, impact, and building something bigger than yourself

Why TopDog Law

  • Real growth: As the firm grows, so do opportunities for advancement and leadership
  • High standards, real support: Clear expectations, coaching, and accountability
  • Culture that matters: Trust, respect, speed, and integrity, without sacrificing humanity
  • Meaningful work: Helping people through some of the hardest moments of their lives

Ready to Build With Us?

If you’re excited by ownership, accountability, growth, and the chance to help build something exceptional from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of TopDog Law.
