raw.description:
Who we are:

At Wagepoint, we're good people. It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.

Our team brings together diverse backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and ideas to make payroll the easiest part of running a business.

We're remote-first, growing, and looking for passionate people who don't settle for the first solution or the way it's been done before. We care deeply about our customers and each other, and understand that when it comes to payroll, getting it right matters.

Our values guide how we work and what we expect from one another:

  • Cultivate Impact by focusing on what matters most and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

  • Unify as One Teamby collaborating openly, communicating clearly, and rallying around shared goals.

  • Stay Curious and Kindby challenging assumptions, learning quickly, and leading with empathy.

If you want to build the future of payroll in a place where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter, look no further!

The Role:

We’re looking for a talentedPrincipal Software Development Engineer - Applied AI, who enjoys tackling hard problems and wants to create meaningful impact for small businesses across Canada.You’ll set the technical strategy for AI Products at Wagepoint, authoring thearchitecture decision records that define platform boundaries, persistence standards, and quality gates for every team building AI features, and setting the guardrails that let Engineering teams experiment with agentic AI.You will report directly to our VP, Engineering.

Your decisions are the ones other engineers’ proposals must cite and align to. Other teams’ roadmaps depend on getting your calls right. You’ll keep Wagepoint’s AI platform choices current against a fast-moving landscape, articulate tradeoffs in terms leadership can act on, and multiply the org through mentorship, pairing with and unblocking the engineers building on your standards.

Like every Principal Engineer at Wagepoint, you also carry broad architectural leadership beyond AI, including well-architected, highly performant distributed systems, and AI-augmented development practices across the SDLC.

Like every engineer at Wagepoint, you do not write software by hand. You’re a major contributor to the software factory, the agentic pipeline of specs, agent implementation, agent review, and human approval that produces our software. You’ll own specific agents within it and work with your teammates to constantly improve the factory itself.

Wagepoint’s goal is Level 4 on our agentic development ladder (engineers approve the spec, agents implement and review, engineers approve the PR), advancing toward Level 5 over time, without ever compromising quality in our highly regulated payroll and tax reporting environment. You are responsible for making that transition possible.

85% of your focus is customer-facing AI products and the platform beneath them. The rest goes to building Wagepoint’s internal use of AI and our software factory.

This role is measured by scope of influence, not just personal output.

What You'll Be Expected To Own:

  • Author the decision records that define how AI gets built org-wide, and resolve cross-team ambiguity with written, cited decisions.

  • Define and maintain the boundary between AI services and the product stack, and own the shared service kit.

  • Make quantified platform calls (evals, observability, persistence) against named vendors with cost models.

  • Define how every AI team gates quality: eval standards in CI/CD, drift monitoring, release criteria.

  • Set resource-isolation and agentic-workflow guardrails, and own the responsible AI and audit posture org-wide.

  • Keep platform choices current against the landscape, and publish dated verification notes and revisit triggers.

  • Lead design of large-scale, distributed, customer-facing systems where AI intersects the product stack, and apply DDD to define domain boundaries.

  • Be a go-to technical resource across teams, unblock high-impact initiatives, and shape engineering-wide standards through RFCs and reviews.

  • Set the org-wide path from today’s baseline to Level 4 of the agentic development ladder and beyond toward Level 5, while holding the quality and compliance bar required in payroll and tax reporting.

What You Bring To The Table:

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with progressively increasing impact, including multiple years designing and operating production LLM/agentic systems at Staff-level scope or above.

  • Proven technical leadership designing distributed systems and microservices for complex domains, with working knowledge of DDD and Clean Architecture principles applied to build highly performant, well-architected systems (prior DDD project experience not required).

  • Full-stack breadth, spanning modern front-end frameworks and a Python back-end, sufficient to lead architecture across the entire product stack, not just AI services. .NET/C# experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Track record of authoring architecture standards adopted beyond your own team, producing decision records that other senior engineers review, cite, and build on.

  • Demonstrated quantified build-vs-buy decisions against named vendors (e.g., eval/observability platforms, vector stores), with cost models and explicitly rejected alternatives.

  • Deep fluency in the current AI platform landscape: stateful agent orchestration, MCP and inter-agent (A2A) interoperability, eval-gated CI/CD, and vector-enabled persistence (PostgreSQL/pgvector, DiskANN-class indexing, managed offerings).

  • A considered point of view on where Wagepoint’s model strategy should be in two years, including whether and where to adopt fine-tuned small language models versus frontier APIs, grounded in cost, latency, and control tradeoffs.

  • Experience defining platform boundaries between AI stacks and an existing product stack (e.g., Python AI services alongside .NET), including shared service-kit libraries other teams consume.

  • Security and governance leadership: resource isolation, agentic workflow guardrails, responsible AI in a regulated, money-movement domain.

  • Executive communication, articulating platform tradeoffs in terms leadership can act on, covering cost, risk, and optionality, not just engineering detail.

  • A high degree of agency, building net-new systems and optimizing API performance where no established pattern exists, forging the path rather than waiting for one, with demonstrated ability to bring other engineers along that path.

  • Demonstrated multiplier effect through mentorship: pairing with, unblocking, and growing senior engineers.

  • A passionate and key contributor to Wagepoint’s software factory, directing and reviewing agentic development while maintaining and improving our high quality and compliance bar.

What we bring to the table:

  • Impact: Dig in and directly contribute to Wagepoint’s growth and success.

  • Culture: Work alongside a team that genuinely enjoys solving problems together, celebrates wins, supports one another through challenges, and still finds time for the occasional terrible joke.

  • Growth: We believe learning is part of the job. We’re committed to helping you Get Better Every Day (a representation of our Stay Curious and Kind value!) by offering professional development, new experiences, and career growth as we continue to evolve.

  • Innovation: Curiosity and experimentation encouraged! Bring ideas, challenge assumptions, responsibly utilize AI, and help shape better ways of working.

  • Remote: Work from wherever you do your best work. Wagepoint has always been remote-first, giving you flexibility, autonomy, and hopefully a little extra time with the people (and pets) you love.

Ready to join the team? Apply now and help us continue making payroll the easiest part of running a business.

Next steps:

If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you! No need for a formal cover letter, just send us your resume and if you’d like, a few lines about what excites you about the opportunity.

If we agree it's a great match, someone from our team will reach out to schedule a call.

Psssst!

In 2026, we were recognized as one of Canada's Best Workplaces for Mental Wellness and Inclusion. That commitment extends to our hiring process, where we strive to create an experience that is welcoming, respectful, and inclusive from day one.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives, and we're committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive.

As a remote company, all interviews are conducted virtually. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to support you!

As part of our hiring process, AI-based tools are used to support the initial review of applications. Rest assured, our People Ops team carefully reviews all applications and makes the final decisions on candidate progression.

SDR Junior (Sales Development Representative)

EdTech - Pharma/Farma
📍Remoto (híbrido opcional si te encuentras en Valencia)

◾ Sobre el proyecto

Desde HR Lean estamos acompañando a Farma Leaders Talento (FLT), en la búsqueda de un/a SDR Junior para su equipo B2C.

Más allá de números o crecimiento, hay algo que define este proyecto:

Su propósito --> transformar la educación ayudando a las personas a alcanzar su mejor versión y cumplir su sueño profesional.

Y no es solo un mensaje bonito. Se traduce en impacto real:

  • Personas que consiguen entrar en la industria pharma sin contactos previos

  • Profesionales que reorientan su carrera hacia algo con más sentido

  • Talento que encuentra oportunidades que antes no estaban a su alcance

Hoy son:

  • +11.000 profesionales en su comunidad

  • +1.000 alumnos formados (empleabilidad cercana al 100%)

  • +200 empresas partner

El área de admisiones es el motor del negocio… y también el punto donde ese propósito se convierte en realidad.

◾ ¿Dónde entras tú?

Buscamos incorporar un/a SDR Junior (Sales Development Representative) que quiera formar parte de este impacto.

No como un rol comercial al uso, sino como la persona que acompaña a los leads en uno de los momentos más importantes: decidir su siguiente paso profesional.

Si te motiva entender a las personas, ayudarles a tomar decisiones con sentido y, además, mejorar cómo funciona todo ese proceso… este rol es para ti.

◾Tu misión comoSDR

Serás responsable de convertir interés en decisiones reales.

Acompañarás a potenciales alumnos desde el primer contacto hasta su entrada en el proceso de admisión, ayudándoles a tomar una decisión informada sobre su futuro profesional.

No vendes un producto. Acompañas decisiones que cambian carreras.

Además, trabajarás con autonomía real: tendrás ownership sobre tu parte del funnel.

  • Decidirás cómo trabajar los leads

  • Detectarás qué no funciona

  • Probarás mejoras y medirás impacto

Aquí:

  • Se trabaja por misiones

  • No hay jerarquías rígidas

  • Se mide impacto, no horas

◾Qué harás en tu día a día

🔹 Inbound & consultoría de ventas

  • Realizar llamadas de asesoramiento a leads interesados.

  • Escuchar, entender motivaciones, detectar barreras y ofrecer soluciones honestas.

  • Acompañar al alumno en todo el ciclo inicial hasta su entrada al proceso de admisión.

🔹 Seguimiento y conversión

  • Gestionar el CRM (HubSpot): notas, estados, segmentación, cadencias.

  • Hacer un seguimiento cuidadoso y ordenado de cada lead.

  • Optimizar métricas clave

🔹 Outbound

  • Buscar nuevas oportunidades: asociaciones, comunidades, perfiles afines.

  • Activar leads fríos con mensajes estratégicos, empatía y constancia.

🔹 Optimización del funnel

  • Alimentar y mantener actualizados los contactos y las acciones en el CRM

  • Analizar métricas y detectar cuellos de botella.

  • Proponer y ejecutar micro-experimentos: scripts, cadencias, automatizaciones.

  • Colaborar activamente con Growth y el resto del equipo para mejorar conversión y calidad del lead

🔹 Mejora continua y construcción de sistema

  • Aportar ideas para escalar el área de admisiones y mejorar la productividad comercial

  • Trabajar con herramientas como Notion, IA y automatizaciones como parte del día a día

  • Participar en dinámicas de sprint (planificación quincenal + revisión + aprendizaje)

◾Lo que estamos buscando

Experiencia y conocimientos

  • 1–2 años de experiencia enventas consultivas B2C o admisiones (idealmente EdTech, sector farmacéutico y/oo entorno startup)

  • Manejo de CRM HubSpot.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales: Notion, IA, automatizaciones.

  • Disponibiiidad para viajar a eventos, ferias y encuentros en las oficinas en Valencia.

  • Inglés B2.

  • Valorable catalán/valenciano.

  • Grado universitario (preferiblemente rama salud).

Mentalidad y habilidades

  • Empatía real y habilidad para escuchar.

  • Comunicación clara, cercana y persuasiva.

  • Organización y criterio para priorizar.

  • Resiliencia para manejar objeciones.

  • Curiosidad, ganas de aprender y mejora continua.

  • Autonomía para tomar decisiones.

Perfil hunter + builder: conviertes, pero también mejoras cómo convertir mejor

Plus

  • Experiencia en EdTech, salud, pharma/farma o entornos startup.

  • Haber trabajado con funnels y métricas de conversión.

  • Iniciativa para proponer mejoras y ejecutar mejoras.

  • Experiencia con metodologías ágiles

◾Qué ofrece el proyecto

🌟 Contrato indefinido desde el primer día.

🌟Flexibilidad total de horario y vacaciones. La cultura es de absoluta confianza, no de control.

🌟 Posibilidad de trabajar en remoto o híbrido si resides en Valencia. Las oficinas están ubicadas en Lanzadera, con vistas al mar 🌊😎. Comidas incluidas cuando trabajas presencial.

🌟Onboarding y encuentros periódicospresencialesen Valencia.

🌟Beneficios sociales entre los que podrás elegir Gym, seguro médico, psicólogo, etc.

🌟Formación continua + clases de idiomas. Acceso a las formaciones de FLT.
🌟Cultura joven, cercana, horizontal y sin jerarquías.

🌟Retiros anuales, Afterworks. ¡Pasarlo bien también es importante!.

🌟Un propósito real: Tu trabajo generará impacto directo en la vida profesional de muchas de personas. Tendrás espacio y autonomía real para crear, experimentar y dejar tu huella.

📩 ¿Cómo aplicar?

Si quieres crecer dentro de una startup educativa referente y te ilusiona acompañar a personas en decisiones importantes:

➡️ Envía tu CV

➡️Cuéntanos por qué este rol te encaja

➡️Te contactaremos para iniciar el proceso

¡Estamos deseando conocerte! 🚀

💡Sobre nosotros

En HR LEAN nos especializamos en búsqueda de talento, desarrollo de recursos humanos y mejora continua, poniendo a las personas en el centro de la organización. Nuestro objetivo es facilitar que los candidatos encuentren la oportunidad laboral que buscan y que las empresas consigan el equipo que necesitan para alcanzar sus objetivos, asegurando una integración adecuada en la cultura y el equipo corporativo.

En HR LEAN, estamos comprometidos con la creación de un entorno laboral inclusivo donde cada individuo sea valorado y respetado por sus talentos y habilidades. Creemos firmemente que la diversidad enriquece nuestras organizaciones y comunidades, y nos esforzamos por garantizar igualdad de oportunidades.

🌱 Asimismo, estamos comprometidos con el medioambiente, intentando reducir al máximo el uso del papel en nuestros procesos de selección.

Senior Solutions Architect –Cloud & AI Optimization

Location: Remote (US Time Zones)
Company: Virtasant

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries.

We help organizations modernize cloud platforms, improve engineering efficiency, and optimize cloud spend through architecture, automation, and FinOps best practices.

Our teams work directly with enterprise customers to identify inefficiencies, drive modernization efforts, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Solutions Architect with deep FinOps and cloud optimization expertise.

This role sits within one of Virtasant's highest-impact customer engagements and requires someone who can confidently work with senior stakeholders, analyze complex cloud environments, and lead initiatives that improve efficiency and reduce spend.

This is not a generic cloud architecture role. The strongest candidates have real experience leading cloud cost optimization programs, understand the technical drivers behind cloud spend, and can connect architecture decisions to financial outcomes.

What You'll Do

FinOps & Cloud Optimization

  • Lead cloud cost optimization initiatives across large enterprise environments

  • Identify waste, inefficiencies, and architectural opportunities for improvement

  • Design governance frameworks that sustain long-term cloud efficiency

  • Analyze cloud usage patterns and spending trends

  • Partner with engineering teams to implement optimization recommendations

Data & Analytics

  • Work with cloud cost and usage data at scale

  • Design and optimize reporting, analytics, and decision-support systems

  • Build insights that drive cost optimization decisions

  • Collaborate with customers on cloud financial visibility initiatives

Client Advisory

  • Work directly with customer stakeholders

  • Lead discovery sessions and optimization reviews

  • Present recommendations to technical and business audiences

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with customers

Technical Leadership

  • Guide engineering and data teams

  • Establish best practices around cloud efficiency

  • Mentor team members

  • Drive architecture decisions that improve both technical and financial outcomes

What We're Looking For

Non-Negotiables

  • Demonstrated FinOps experience

  • Proven cloud cost optimization experience

  • Strong AWS experience

  • Strong SQL skills

  • Strong Python skills

  • Customer-facing consulting experience

  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly

  • Experience driving measurable cost reduction initiatives

Important: Candidates who have cloud experience but cannot demonstrate meaningful FinOps experience will not be considered.

Technical Experience

FinOps

  • Cloud cost optimization

  • Cost governance

  • Cost allocation

  • Showback and chargeback models

  • Savings Plans and Reserved Instances

  • Rightsizing

  • Cloud economics

AWS & Data

  • AWS-native analytics services

  • Athena

  • Cost and usage reporting

  • Data modeling

  • Medallion architecture concepts

  • Large-scale data analysis

Software & Automation

  • Python

  • SQL

  • Automation

  • Reporting pipelines

  • Data transformation workflows

Platform & Infrastructure (Preferred)

  • Kubernetes

  • Cloud-native platforms

  • Containerized workloads

AI (Nice to Have)

  • Experience using AI tools in engineering or analytics workflows

  • Familiarity with LLMs and AI-assisted development

Consulting & Business Skills

Strong candidates will demonstrate:

  • Executive communication

  • Stakeholder management

  • Problem framing

  • Technical consulting

  • Data-driven decision making

  • Ability to connect technical recommendations to business outcomes

How We Work

The people who succeed in this role are:

  • Analytical and detail-oriented

  • Comfortable working directly with customers

  • Strong communicators

  • Curious problem solvers

  • Hands-on and technically credible

  • Focused on measurable outcomes

Why Virtasant

At Virtasant, you will:

  • Work on high-impact cloud optimization programs

  • Partner with demanding enterprise customers

  • Help customers save millions through better engineering and cloud decisions

raw.description:
Call for Experts – Technical and Writing Support Services

IESC is a nonprofit organization dedicated to equitable, sustainable economic growth in developing countries. IESC believes that a robust private sector is a foundation for resilient nations and strong communities. Since 1964 IESC has helped to grow small and medium enterprises around the world and strengthened the systems and institutions that support them. By deploying a mix of technical assistance and volunteer expert support, IESC works with emerging industries, financial institutions, and governments to stabilize economic environments, increase opportunity, and promote growth.

IESC is seeking technical specialists/writers in various technical fields, particularly in trade, youth and workforce development, market-driven agriculture, business enabling environment, enterprise finance and investment, to assist with new business/proposal development and program reports on a consulting basis. The technical specialists/writers will work closely with IESC’s new business team and the relevant technical team to respond to RFPs/RFAs issued by USAID and other donors as assigned as well as contribute to program reporting. The consultants will offer in-depth knowledge in relevant technical fields and will be responsible for providing background information as well as applicable solutions in the target technical areas. The consultants will serve as lead or support technical writers for proposals and programmatic reports and develop feasible and relevant strategies and implementation plans in response to solicitations and programmatic needs.

Duties:

The Specialists/Writers will undertake some or all of the following specific tasks for proposal development:

  • Write the technical approach or specific technical proposal sections, as requested
  • Absorb desk research provided by IESC and conduct independent desk research, as needed
  • Review and analyze the solicitation and identify and highlight issues/questions that require further research
  • Offer options for effective approaches to achieve the goals of the program
  • Develop annotated outlines within designated page allotment (planned per subsection) responsive to bid document that follows IESC provided templates
  • Participate in design meetings with IESC, as requested
  • Design the program approach and key activities, including guidance on the cost of activities.
  • Provide input on the design of graphics reflective of the proposed technical approach
  • Conduct capture trips to gather information necessary to prepare a tailored technical approach, assess the feasibility of approach, ground truth collected information, and interview local experts and partners
  • Work closely with, and incorporate technical input from local resource people and partners as appropriate including local technical advisors
  • Incorporate written and oral comments/recommendations from Proposal Review Panels
  • Recommend feasible organizational structure and assist with recruiting expat and local consultants and staff, as needed
  • Other tasks as assigned

The Specialists/Writers may provide some or all of the following support for programmatic reporting:

  • Design, implement, and report on program and/or component level evaluations. Work closely with field team in the design of questions, data collection, and in analysis of the data.
  • Design and create knowledge products, such as case studies, toolkits, resource/best practices guides, etc.
  • Contribute in writing programmatic reports, particularly mid-term and final project reports.
  • Conduct and report on desk level research and secondary market research reports to complement field-based knowledge and to share examples and ideas of similar project ideas in other parts of the world.

Qualifications:

The technical fields where we seek talent include, but are not limited to:

  • Value chain/Agribusiness analysis and development
  • Enterprise development
  • Workforce development
  • Youth strategies related totrade, youth and workforce development, market-driven agriculture, business enabling environment, enterprise finance and investment
  • Gender strategies related totrade, youth and workforce development, market-driven agriculture, business enabling environment, enterprise finance and investment
  • Entrepreneurship
  • Trade capacity building related to business enabling environment, policy, regulations, and procedures, to export business enhancement
  • Microfinance/Access to Finance/Financial Inclusion
  • SME Finance/Banking/Investment
  • Value chain/Agriculture finance
  • Impact/Emerging market investing
  • Digital Finance/mobile banking
  • Private sector approaches in Clean Power/Energy, Health care, and Tourism

The relevant knowledge and skill sets where we seek talent include, but are not limited to:

  • Excellent writing skills and proven capabilities in proposal development.
  • Demonstrated technical knowledge in the fields of economic growth and development finance are required. However, it is not required that each specialist/writer have expertise in all categories.
  • Applicants should have a minimum five years of experience working in international development and experience with USAID and other donor proposal and procurement processes.
  • On-the-ground technical implementation experience is preferred.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills: Ability to work under pressure in order to meet deadlines, attention to detail, thoroughness and accuracy are critical.
  • Excellent team communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills - including written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fluency in English language is required.
  • Knowledge of other languages, such as French and Arabic is a plus.
  • U.S. citizen or eligibility to work in the U.S.

IESC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Job Description:

Job Description

The Network Security Architect will design and build the network security architecture our environment runs on, from firewall and segmentation design through cloud network architecture, and will stay engaged through implementation alongside engineering, not hand off a design and move on.

The Network Security Architect role sits within the Chief Information Security Officer Office, reporting to the Director of Security Architecture and Engineering (SA&E).

Essential Functions

· Designs network security architecture from the ground up: firewall policy and configuration, network segmentation, Zero Trust access design, and cloud network architecture in Microsoft Azure.

· Leads technical migrations end to end: assesses the current environment, designs the target state, builds the configuration, and manages the cutover.

· Works directly alongside engineering through the build and implementation phase of every project they design, adjusting the design in real time when engineering encounters something the design did not account for. This role is expected to close the gap between architecture and engineering, not operate on one side of it.

· Reviews existing network security architecture, identifies gaps, and designs the remediation, including hands on work to resolve technical debt in legacy configurations.

· Assesses, scopes, and estimates the work and hours required to deliver security architecture components of larger projects and programs.

· Serves as the technical expert and trusted advisor to engineering, IT, and business partners on network security design questions.

· Documents and diagrams architecture in both conceptual and physical form, including the underlying configuration, not just high level diagrams.

· Works assigned Request Security Architecture (RSA) tickets and related efforts in ServiceNow.

· Stays current on emerging network security technologies and threats and incorporates them into architecture as needed.

Additional Responsibilities

· Performs other duties as assigned.

Skills and Abilities

· Demonstrated ability to take a loosely defined problem, perform the discovery work independently, and produce an implementable design, not just a conceptual recommendation.

· Advanced, hands on knowledge of network technologies: protocols, design concepts, segmentation, and access control.

· Advanced, hands on knowledge of security technologies: encryption, data protection, access privilege design.

· Direct configuration experience with firewall platforms, not solely policy or diagram level experience.

· Comfortable working side by side with engineers through build and cutover, including off hours implementation windows when required.

· Strong communication skills, able to explain technical design decisions clearly to both engineers and non technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required Computer Science, Information Security, or related field
  • Seven (7) years or more Experience in an Information Security Architect role required
  • Seven (7) years or more Experience with regulatory compliance and information security frameworks (NIST 800/CSF, ISO 27001, COBIT, etc.) required
  • Network technologies including protocols, design concepts, and access control advanced required
  • Security technologies including encryption, data protection, access privileges advanced required
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Linux systems intermediate required
  • Knowledge of both regular expressions (regex) and JSON intermediate required
  • Other Information Security Certification (CISSP, GIAC, etc.)
  • Experience using APIs
  • Experience with CloudFormation, Terraform, Azure Resource Manager, or GCP Cloud Deployment Manager Templates
  • In-depth experience in one or more of the following CSP - Microsoft Azure, AWS, and GCP installation configuration and administration of security features and services
  • Expertise in architecting and working in a DevSecOps environment
  • Security skills should include areas such as access control, runtime defense /anti-malware, and vulnerability management and etc.
  • Experience working with internal business customers, architecting, deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting infrastructure security products
  • One or more Palo Alto Network certifications required such as – PCNSA, PCNSE, PCCSE, PCSAE.

Travel

0-10%

None

About SDG Group

At SDG Group, we are global leaders in Data, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence. Since 1994, we have supported major national and international organizations through their digital transformation journeys, helping them turn data into strategic assets capable of driving real business impact.

Our Data Technologies team is where high-value data solutions are designed and evolved for clients across multiple sectors. We work on driving modern architectures, scalable operating models, and advanced data management capabilities, always from a perspective of innovation, quality, and technical excellence.

We are looking for Data Architects to join our general Data team, whether your background leans more toward Big Data, Cloud, or Data Management, we'd love to hear from you.

➡️ What will your day-to-day look like?

🔹 Help design data architectures that are scalable and aligned with business goals.

🔹 Support the definition of standards for data management, integration, and use.

🔹 Contribute to the design of modern data platforms, with a focus on security and efficiency.

🔹 Take part in digital transformation initiatives, helping evolve data ecosystems toward more flexible, data-as-a-product models.

🔹 Work with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to translate needs into practical architecture solutions.

🔹 Promote good practices around data quality, governance, and continuous improvement.

An Engineering Manager in the Acquisition Portfolio leads a team of 5-8 full-stack engineers, bridging technical expertise and product partnerships. The day involves being a hands-on technical partner to product management and tech leads, overseeing delivery, and maintaining hands-on technical understanding. This includes actively guiding architecture, code quality, and system design decisions to ensure scalable, high-quality solutions aligned with business objectives.

Overall Tasks and Responsibilities

Overall, the role requires providing strategic direction across teams, establishing operating practices, priorities, and metrics aligned with organizational goals. The manager interprets and applies company-wide policies within the context of engineering delivery, driving effective execution and continuous improvement. They collaborate closely with Product, business leaders, and senior stakeholders to translate complex compensation and advisor needs into well-designed technical solutions. Additionally, the manager leads technical discussions and forums that shape direction, ensure clarity, and support the delivery of business and technology outcomes. The team maintains and builds highly integrated products and experiences, requiring cross-functional collaboration across Thrivent.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Designing Solutions

  • Review technical solution design and architecture and provide guidance and direction.
  • Take part in system design and architecture conversations with the team to land approaches to deliver solutions.
  • Review technical solution and supports the execution of the solution

Developing Software

  • Has Developed software. Can read code and stays up to date on best practices.
  • Ensure Code reviews are completed - Problem solving and analytical skills

Learning and applying new techniques

  • Promotes and empowers sharing ideas, best practices, etc. They need to make space so teams can take time for these activities.
  • Anticipates and analyzes trends in technology and assesses the impact of emerging technologies on the business

Collaborating within team

  • Supports the team agile practices and learning events / trainings
  • Helps break down barriers for the team
  • Engages in sprint demos; Understands the desired and actual outcomes as well as the technology delivered by the team
  • Partner with Product Manager on Initiatives/ Features/ Epics and provides clarity on desired outcomes as well as technical expertise.
  • Collaborates with Product manager for strategies, operating plans, targets and measures for product groups
  • Creating a positive team environment where individuals have psychological safety and work collaboratively while understanding, respecting, challenging and appreciating each other’s ideas

Collaborating across teams

  • Supports and empowers teams to broker solutions across products
  • Understands how the product integrates with other products and ensures consistency in approach to work towards a common goal / outcome.
  • Builds strong working relationships with peers across teams
  • Proactively identifies cross team challenges and works to empower teams in solve collaboratively

Collaborating across the organization

  • Align your team with the priorities of the company and the technology organization for a given product area

Setting product/platform technology strategy

  • Participates in setting the product and platform technology vision, strategies, initiatives, roadmaps , objectives and alignments
  • Represents the business value of technology upgrades, etc. and influences prioritization in the product roadmap
  • Empowers the team to select the right tool and platforms for the given product area.

Defining Engineering standards/patterns

  • Collaborating with Engineers to ensure Engineering practices and be an advocate to bring the engineering disciplines.
  • Promoting engineering practices and continuous improvement such as develops and observability
  • Contributes to the creation of enterprise frameworks and patterns

DevOps

  • Define and supports the development Lifecyle processes
  • Supports the team and removes barriers to resolving production incidents/problems
  • DevOps continuously evaluated through observability, monitoring and alerting
  • Understands the health of technology products and promotes prioritization of work to maintain and continuously improve
  • Serve as an escalation point in product level support for ongoing maintenance and production issues

Selecting & Managing Technology Vendors

  • Be an advocate to the team to define criteria’s for selecting the right platform/technology
  • Guides the team to build consensus on an approach and driving a build vs buy decision with the team. In a buy decision, works with the team to decide on criteria and vendor selection.
  • Execute or manage the overall technology solutions, platforms for the product groups and associated vendor relationships.

Coaching Engineers

  • Holding regular 1:1s with team members and team meeting,
  • Provides constructive feedback, guidance and coaching to help engineers grow their skills and experience.
  • Provides career planning advice to engineers and creates development plans to help them achieve their career goals which leverages their skills and capabilities and provides them with learning opportunities.

Recruiting/building talent

  • Leads the process of selecting and engaging the right consulting partners
  • Planning in advance for future people needs for the product groups, collaborate with the other teams on the recruitment process
  • Recruits, develops, and sustains a high-performing team while promoting a culture of shared accountability, operational excellence, and partnership across the organization.
  • Models Thrivent’s leadership competencies – courage, collaboration, and commitment by demonstrating resiliency, working together to make the best decisions, and holding yourself and others accountable. ​
  • Supports and/or develops an environment in which Thrivent employees and colleagues are focused on continuous improvement, exceptional employee engagement, and an unwavering commitment to our clients. Shapes and/or supports a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients.
  • Manage a team of direct and indirect staff

​

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or other technical field or equivalent work experience
  • 8+ years of progressively responsible positions in Information Technology including 5+ years’ experience in IT discipline, e.g., customer relationship management, portfolio strategy and roadmap development.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience in all aspects of a specific IT discipline, e.g. IT/LOB customer relationship management, portfolio strategy and/or demand management.
  • 3+ years’ management/supervisory experience in specific IT functional area discipline, e.g. applications development or equivalent skills leading major technical projects with accountability for enforcing talent management needs and performance standards.
  • Demonstrated leadership and experience managing multidiscipline, high-performance work teams.
  • Strong competency in project management and execution of multiple or large projects.
  • Experience working with customers to develop solutions to complex business problems.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with internal/external stakeholders to support business initiatives.
  • Proven ability to function in an environment which requires flexibility, good judgment and intelligent decision making, often based on limited information and/or extreme conditions.
  • Ability to formulate, implement and evaluate plans, programs and procedures applicable to customer relationship and demand management.

Preferred:

  • MBA
  • Financial Services industry experience
  • Experience in IT planning and business relationship management
  • Experience working in a matrix management organization
  • Experience with product development and management

North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries.

Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment.

We’re a multicultural, fully remote company uniting over 50 in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas.

Role Summary

North Star Network are looking for a site coordinator to oversee the daily editorial and operational performance of Chilean sports site Al Aire Libre, ensuring high-quality, timely, and audience-focused content across the site.

Reporting to the Head of Media, this role is responsible for coordinating local editorial operations, managing contributors, monitoring content performance, and ensuring that editorial output aligns with the company's overall strategy, SEO objectives, and quality standards.

The Site Coordinator serves as the bridge between the central media department and the Chilean editorial team, maintaining high editorial standards while ensuring local relevance through a strong understanding of the domestic football landscape.

This role requires excellent organizational and people management skills, sound editorial judgement, effective communication, and a data-driven mindset.

Key Responsibilities

1. Editorial Coordination & Planning

  • Manage the day-to-day editorial calendar of Al Aire Libre.

  • Align local editorial planning with central media strategy, audience objectives, and traffic targets.

  • Ensure content reflects the site's editorial identity while maintaining a strong focus on Chilean football and topics relevant to the local audience.

  • Coordinate assignments with Writers, Editors, SEO, Tipsters and Social Media teams to maintain an efficient publishing workflow.

  • Greater integration of value-adding AI-led/assisted content into editorial workflow.

  • Identify key sports news stories, evergreen opportunities, and priority pages requiring regular updates based on editorial value, audience demand, and SEO performance.

  • Ensure content planning balances breaking news, analysis, features, evergreen, and search-driven content.

2. Workflow & Team Management

  • Supervise the day-to-day workflow of local editorial contributors and freelance writers.

  • Distribute assignments, monitor deadlines, and ensure all content meets editorial and publishing standards.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for the Chilean editorial team, providing guidance, feedback, coaching, and performance follow-up.

  • Identify staffing or resource requirements.

  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and development of new editorial contributors where required.

  • Serve as the primary communication link between the Chilean editorial team and headquarters.

3. Performance Monitoring & Reporting

  • Monitor key performance indicators including traffic, engagement, search visibility, rankings, and publishing output.

  • Use tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Looker Studio to evaluate editorial performance.

  • Collaborate with Media Data Analyst to produce regular reports highlighting successes, opportunities, and recommended improvements.

4. Quality Control & SEO

  • Ensure all published content meets editorial, SEO, Anti-Spam and compliance standards.

  • Review articles for accuracy, clarity, readability, consistency, and adherence to editorial guidelines.

  • Ensure writers apply SEO best practices, including headline writing, metadata, internal linking, keyword optimisation, and content structure.

  • Coordinate with the Head of Social Media to maximise distribution and visibility of priority content.

  • Maintain publishing standards, templates, formatting consistency, and internal workflows.

Candidate Profile

  • Native-level Spanish speaker with excellent written and editorial skills.

  • Working proficiency in English, enabling effective communication with international teams.

  • Excellent knowledge of Chilean football, including the domestic leagues, clubs, players, and football media landscape.

  • Previous experience coordinating editorial teams or managing digital content operations.

  • Strong understanding of digital publishing workflows and editorial planning.

  • Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals and best practices for editorial content.

  • Comfortable with data, and experience using analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, or Looker Studio.

  • Excellent organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced sports news environment.

Out of Scope / Role Boundaries

The Site Coordinator is responsible for editorial coordination, operational management, and content performance for the Chilean site.

The role does not include:

  • Commercial, advertising, or partnership negotiations.

  • Sustainable growth in site authority/notoriety, traffic, audience engagement, and search performance.

  • Consistent delivery of high-quality content aligned with editorial calendars.

  • Strong SEO implementation across editorial output.

  • Positive collab with contributors and central media teams.

  • Effective leadership and development of the local editorial team.

  • Clear communication and collaboration between Chile and headquarters.

  • Strong editorial coverage of Chilean football, delivering relevance, authority, and audience growth.

raw.title: Senior Financial Reporting Analyst
raw.excerpt: Symetra has an exciting new opportunity to join us as a Reinsurance Senior Financial Reporting Analyst!
raw.description:
Symetra has an exciting new opportunity to join us as a Reinsurance Senior Financial Reporting Analyst!

About the role

This role is a Senior Financial Reporting Analyst on the Finance – Reinsurance Reporting team, focused on reinsurance accounting and financial analysis for life and annuity products. The position requires strong technical expertise in reinsurance structures (including Modco and funds withheld) and supports the delivery of accurate financial reporting and disclosures. The role also partners cross-functionally and plays a key part in implementing new reinsurance transactions in a dynamic environment.

What you will do

  • Support research and documentation of technical accounting matters related to reinsurance under GAAP, U.S. Statutory, and Bermuda Statutory frameworks
  • Prepare analyses of accounting treatments for new and complex transactions, including impacts to financial statements and operational processes
  • Coordinate with external auditors as needed to support reviews and discussions
  • Lead key components of the reinsurance accounting close process, including:
    • Preparing and reviewing journal entries, general ledger reconciliations, and reporting schedules
    • Analyzing variances and delivering management reports and key financial outputs
  • Demonstrate deep expertise in assigned areas while maintaining a strong understanding of related processes and cross-functional impacts
  • Drive ad hoc initiatives and special projects, including:
    • Supporting the implementation of new reinsurance treaties
    • Identifying and executing process improvements and operational efficiencies
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Actuarial, Tax, Legal, and other partners to evaluate and operationalize new reinsurance arrangements

Why Work at Symetra

Here’s what some of our employees have to say about why they work at Symetra:

“We're big enough to make an impact on the country, but small enough to care and know who you are and what you're contributing to the organization. All new ideas are welcome!” - Stephanie F., VP Customer Service & Operations

“From day one, I felt welcomed and encouraged to bring my full self to work. Symetra truly lives up to its commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion—it's more than just words here; it's part of the culture.” - Whitney T., Talent Development

What we offer you

Benefits and Perks

We don’t take a “one-size-fits-all” approach when it comes to our employees. Our programs are designed to make your life better both at work and at home.

  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements
  • Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan and take advantage of immediate vesting and company matching up to 6%
  • Paid time away including vacation and sick time, flex days and ten paid holidays
  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching
  • Want more details? Check out ourSymetra Benefits Overview

Compensation

Salary Range: $79,900 - $133,200 base plus eligibility for the company annual bonus program.

Who You Are:

  • High School Diploma is required, plus a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
  • 3+ years of experience in reinsurance accounting of life and annuity insurance and reinsurance, with exposure to complex reinsurance arrangements (such as modco, coinsurance with funds withheld, etc.) is preferred
  • Proficiency in the fundamentals of accounting principles for life insurance and annuity products
  • CPA or CPA-eligible, preferred
  • Experience in public accounting, including preparation, review, and audit of financial statements and related footnote disclosures
  • Goal-oriented with a track record of task and project completion
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, as the need arises (quarter and year-ends, ad hoc projects)
  • Proven ability to interact effectively and communicate complex reinsurance accounting guidelines and policies in an understandable manner to various levels of management, staff, and auditors
  • High expectations for themselves, with an irresistible urge to exceed them
  • Ability to perform assignments independently and adapt to changing priorities
  • Creativity, problem solving, and decision-making skills
  • A positive attitude and sense of humor!
We empower inclusion
At Symetra, we aspire to be the most inclusive insurance company in the country. We're building a place where every employee feels valued, respected, and has opportunities to contribute.
Inclusion is about recognizing our assumptions, considering multiple perspective, and removing barriers. We accept and celebrate diverse experiences, identities, and perspectives, because lifting each other up fuels thought and builds a stronger, more innovative company. We invite you to learn more about our efforts here.
Creating a world where more people have access to financial freedom
Symetra is a national financial services company dedicated to helping people achieve their financial goals and feel confident about the future. In our daily work, we're guided by the principles of Value, Transparency and Sustainability. This means we provide products and services people need at a competitive price, we communicate clearly and openly so people understand what they're buying, and we design products--and operate our company--to stand the test of time. We're committed to showing up for our communities, lifting up our employees, and standing up for diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Join our team and help us create a world where more people have access to financial freedom.
For more information about our careers visit:
Work Authorization
Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.
Please review Symetra's Remote Network Minimum Requirements:
As a remote-first organization committed to providing a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees' internet connection:
  • Minimum Internet Speed:100 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, in alignment with the FCC's definition of "broadband."
  • Internet Type:Fiber, Cable (e.g., Comcast, Spectrum), or DSL.
  • Not Permissible:Satellite (e.g., Starlink), cellular broadband (hotspot or otherwise), any other wireless technology, or wired dial-up.
When applying to jobs at Symetra you'll be asked to test your internet speed and confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra's standard as outlined above.

Identity Verification

Symetra is committed to fair and secure hiring practices. For all roles, candidates will be required (after the initial phone screen) to be on video for all interviews. Symetra will take affirmative steps at key points in the process to verify that a candidate is not seeking employment fraudulently, e.g. through use of a false identity.
Failure to comply with verification procedures may result in:
  • Disqualification from the recruitment process
  • Withdrawal of a job offer
  • Termination of employment and other criminal and/or civil remedies, if fraud is discovered

About the Role

As an Associate EDX Analyst, you will process ongoing feeds to find and correct data issues, including eligibility and contract rules. You will bring a basic understanding of analytical techniques and ability to escalate issues as needed after data interpretation. You’re driven to learn more about business analysis, processes and systems to help develop your skill set.

What you will do

  • Manage conflicts, issues and changes in order to ensure that stakeholders and the end users remain in agreement on the data exchange.
  • Utilize requirements and communicate them to stakeholders.

  • Identify business needs, refine and clarify the definition of the needs and validate the solution meets the needs.

Job Highlights:

As an Enterprise Systems Architect, you’ll play a critical role in designing, evolving, and optimizing the core infrastructure that supports mission‑critical systems across the organization. This is a highly visible opportunity to influence enterprise architecture decisions while partnering with IT leaders and technical teams to ensure scalable, secure, and resilient solutions.

We’re seeking candidates with strong technical infrastructure experience, including compute platforms, network protocols, storage technologies, data centers, and cloud environments. You’ll bring expert‑level knowledge of virtualization and cloud platforms, with a proven ability to translate business needs into modern, efficient architectural designs. Experience in cloud strategy and hybrid environments is key, with AWS expertise highly valued—an AWS Solutions Architect certification is preferred.

If you’re driven by solving complex problems, shaping enterprise technology direction, and building forward‑looking infrastructure solutions, this role offers the scope, impact, and visibility to take your career to the next level.

Job Summary:

Develops an overall view of the organization's IT technology and operations in relation to its IT strategy. Oversees multiple architecture domains like application, data, security and technology and ensures they align with the organization's standards. Works with systems architects to create roadmaps for all domains, determine operational gaps and develops methods for improvement.

Our Vision & Mission

We envision a world in which all people have access to high quality and enduring solutions to improve and maintain their health and well-being. MCD Global Health aspires to be a premier partner of choice and a recognized leader, innovator, and trusted partner in healthcare and public health program development, implementation and evaluation. Our mission is to improve the health and well-being of people worldwide through enduring, high-quality, cost-effective, and universally accessible public health solutions. MCD operates impactful programs both in the U.S.A. and internationally.

MCD seeks a Digital Health Program Manager for its new program that leads the administration and implementation of technology and innovation initiatives under the state of Maine’s new Rural Health Transformation Program.

This position is a remote position based in Maine; relocation expenses will not be provided. Some travel within the State of Maine will be required.

Requirements

Digital Health Program Managers

Grade Level: 6

Anticipated Salary: $74,000-$88,000

Reporting Relationship: Director, Digital Health Initiative

The Digital Health Program Managers will partner with sub-awardees and contractors to implement digital health projects and programs in varying topic areas and technical approaches, including but not limited to: telehealth integration in schools, long-term care facilities, acute care, oral health, maternal and perinatal behavioral health, implementation of peer-to-peer telehealth models, remote patient monitoring programs and digital health navigation. This will include provision of technical assistance and training where relevant and ensuring that sub-awardees are achieving project milestones on time and within budget allowances.  

The essential functions of the position include:

Program Management:

  • Support sub-awardees and contractors in implementing digital health projects across multiple domains. 

  • Provide technical assistance and training to ensure effective adoption of digital health tools. 

  • Monitor and report on project milestones, budgets, and deliverables. 

  • Facilitate integration of telehealth and digital health solutions into diverse healthcare environments. 

  • Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation in Maine’s digital health initiatives. 

Teamwork:

  • Participate in relevant workgroups and/or committees

  • Participate in MCD Global Health strategic planning as required.

  • Lead by example, foster a sense of teamwork, inspire a sense of personal and professional accountability and promote positive morale that supports productivity and high quality of work for the individual team, the US Programs and MCD Global Health as a whole.

  • Work to ensure that project activities and planning are directed toward the advancement of the US Programs and MCD Global Health as a whole.

Business Development:

  • Partner with the US Programs Business Development team to assist in the development and submission of grant and contract requests to sustain and grow MCD activities pertaining to telehealth and other areas of interest, including both US Programs and international.

  • Stay current in the field by participating in available trainings related to current grants and contracts, reading and reviewing relevant literature, and subscribing to relevant listserv(s) as appropriate. Strive to ensure that project implementation is responsive to the latest research and innovations and facilities growth in MCD Global Health's portfolio.

  • Participate regularly in conferences and meetings to develop and maintain relationships with current and prospective donors, clients, contractors, or government officials while keeping abreast of trends in the field.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Public Health, Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. 

  • Training or certification in project/program management (e.g., PMP, CAPM) preferred. 

  • Familiarity with digital health technologies and telehealth integration strongly desired. 

Experience:

  • 5–7 years of experience in program management within healthcare, public health, or digital health initiatives. 

  • Demonstrated success managing multi-stakeholder projects with contractors, sub-awardees, and provider organizations. 

  • Experience implementing telehealth programs across diverse settings (schools, long-term care, acute care, oral health, maternal/perinatal behavioral health). 

  • Background in providing technical assistance and training to healthcare organizations or community partners.

The Accounts Payable Executive – Finance role is part of Sage’s Global Services Finance Accounts Payable Team. The team is responsible for supporting the wider Finance function by ensuring the accurate processing of supplier invoices, timely payments, and effective management of accounts payable activities. The role plays a critical part in maintaining strong supplier relationships, ensuring compliance with internal controls, and supporting the organization’s financial operations through efficient and accurate transaction processing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and support established Accounts Payable processes, controls, and procedures to ensure compliance with company policies and financial standards.

  • Accurately process supplier invoices in Epicor and ensure purchase orders are correctly matched with related invoices through Proactis (P2P) in accordance with Sage service standards.

  • Prepare draft payment runs and refund payments for review and approval.

  • Maintain and update supplier and customer master data, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of records.

  • Perform supplier statement reconciliations and investigate, resolve, and clear reconciling items in a timely manner.

  • Adhere to agreed Accounts Payable month-end close schedules and ensure all activities are completed within defined timelines.

  • Respond to supplier inquiries and resolve payment and invoice-related queries within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Sage to effectively resolve invoice, payment, and account-related issues.

  • Support management in implementing new processes, systems, and controls, while actively contributing to process improvement initiatives.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and service quality within the Accounts Payable function.

  • Ensure compliance with internal financial controls, company policies, and regulatory requirements.

Skills, Knowledge & Competencies

Functional Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of Accounts Payable processes and financial transaction management.

  • Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial controls.

  • Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy in data processing and reconciliation activities.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Effective organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team environment.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality service to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Proactive approach to identifying process improvement opportunities and driving operational efficiency.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.

  • 1–2 years of experience in Accounting, Finance, Accounts Payable, or a related finance function.

  • Understanding of double-entry accounting principles and familiarity with US GAAP and/or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) is preferred.

  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including functions such as Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, SUMIF/SUMIFS, and data analysis techniques.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Word and PowerPoint.

  • Experience with ERP systems (e.g., Epicor) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) platforms (e.g., Proactis) is desirable.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with changing priorities.

  • Prior experience in a shared services or global finance environment would be an advantage.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.  As a business and as an organization with an increasingly agile workforce, we're open to flexible working arrangements where appropriate.

Discover Your Path to eCommerce Freedom with GTE!

Take your career to the next level by joining GTE, a fast-growing global direct-to-consumer company building and scaling high-performing eCommerce brands across international markets.

At GTE, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside talented professionals from around the world, take ownership of meaningful work, and contribute directly to the growth of a fast-moving global eCommerce business.

Discover your path to eCommerce freedom with us!

The Company in a Nutshell

Founded in 2018 and headquartered in the Netherlands, GTE()is on a mission to build the most efficient global direct-to-consumer infrastructure and grow into one of the world's leading eCommerce companies.

We operate a growing portfolio of scalable, high-performing brands and 50+ online stores across international markets. Our global team of 160+ remote eCommerce professionals brings together expertise across marketing, growth, customer service, human resources, supply chain, and other key areas of the business.

Our success is driven by a shared commitment to hard work, freedom with responsibility, continuous improvement, and excellence. We believe in giving our people the freedom to work independently while holding ourselves accountable for delivering meaningful results.

The Upsides of Working with Us

  • Thrive in a results-driven environment with the autonomy to shape your own approach.

  • Achieve a great work-life balance with remote work and a flexible schedule.

  • Enjoy a competitive salary that reflects your skills and contributions.

  • Collaborate with a dynamic remote team.

  • Be a key player in our rapidly growing company.

We’re on the lookout for aProduct Importerto join our expanding team and drive our company’s growth!

The Challenge

As we grow and open more stores, we need a Product Importer to help expand our product catalog efficiently. In this role, you'll import products into our Shopify stores and create compelling product pages that drive sales. Success requires familiarity with Shopify listing processes and tools like Kopy and DSers, as well as the ability to precisely manage high volumes of imports. Your work will support our expanding operations and ensure seamless product launches.

Day in the Life of a Product Importer at GTEcom

  • Import new products into our Shopify store, ensuring accurate product details, pricing, and inventory levels.

  • Create and optimize product pages with compelling descriptions, images, and attributes to enhance customer engagement and conversions.

  • Monitor and update inventory levels, coordinating with relevant teams for restocking when needed.

  • Regularly review and maintain data accuracy across product listings, promptly addressing any errors or discrepancies.

  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure product pages align with brand guidelines and are visually appealing.

  • Utilize tools like Shopify, Kopy, and DSers to streamline product listing processes, manage order fulfillment, and update import and research reports regularly.

  • Prepare and analyze reports related to product performance, inventory, and trends to support decision-making.

Drivers of Success for This Role

  • Achieve daily and monthly import targets for assigned brands, contributing to the overall team targets.

  • Maintain high accuracy in imports and QA checks, minimizing errors to ensure seamless product data integration.

Your Team When You Join Us

You’ll be part of a vibrant Growth Expansion Team, working hand-in-hand with our dynamic Growth Expansion Manager. Work alongside amazing and talented team members from France, Germany, Pakistan, and the Philippines, all working remotely but closely together to elevate and boost our Bulk stores. Get ready to collaborate with a group that's as enthusiastic about success as you are!

We Would Love to Hear from You If…

  • You have at least 6 months of experience in a similar role working for an eCommerce company, specifically in the dropshipping model.

  • You have at least 6 months of experience working with Shopifyand similar product import tools like Kopy, DSers, Spocket, or Zendrop.

  • You have proven expertise in data gathering and reporting, particularly using Excel or Google Sheets.

  • You have a high level of attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in product listings and reports.

  • You are proactive and able to take initiative in identifying and solving issues.

  • Prior experience in a similar role is essential.

If you are excited about the opportunity and feel like you are a good fit, we encourage you to apply today and talk to one of our recruiters. We look forward to seeing how your skills and experience align with our vision. If you're unsure, we still welcome your application and would be happy to discuss other potential roles that may be a good fit for you.

Overview of Our Interview Process

  • Application Submission– We’ll start by reviewing your application.

  • TestGorilla Assessment– You will be invited to take a 19-minute written examination to help us assess your fitness for the role and our team. Please note that passing this stage is crucial to moving forward in the hiring process.

  • Initial Contact (Initial Interview)– Our Recruiter will reach out to you to discuss the next steps.

  • Final Interview -Meet with the Hiring Manager or our CEO. If the Hiring Manager is not our CEO, you may have another call with our CEO.

  • Offer Discussion– If all goes well, we'll discuss the offer and invite you to our pre-onboarding process.

  • Pre-onboarding Process - This includes a background check to verify your identity and declared address, as well as a reference check with three of your provided references.

  • Onboarding:Once all checks are completed, we’ll initiate the onboarding process.

Quick Tip:Our messages might land in your spam folder. Give it a look so you don’t miss any news from us!

raw.description:
Over Staxxer

E-commerce is groeiende en daarmee ook het aantal ambitieuze e-commerce verkopers. Omdat je als e-commerce verkoper groter denkt dan je eigen land, wil je al snel de grens over. Daar komen complexe Europese btw-vraagstukken bij kijken. Ons doel? Internationale verkoop makkelijk maken, door de hele backoffice te automatiseren. We onderscheiden onszelf van het traditionele (vaak stoffige) imago van accounting en boekhouding door het nét even anders aan te pakken.

Dit doen wij door ons toegankelijk op te stellen, en informele communicatie zonder poespas. Wij nemen onder andere de btw-vraagstukken van onze klanten van A tot Z uit handen. Hiervoor maken wij gebruik van onze eigen slimme software en service. De oprichters van Staxxer zijn geen fiscalisten, juristen of btw-experts, maar komen uit de e-commerce wereld. Daardoor weten wij goed wat de e-commerce verkoper nodig heeft en voorzien daarin met goede service en snelle, informele communicatie.

Over de functie

In deze veelzijdige rol als administratief medewerker ben jij verantwoordelijk voor btw-verplichtingen in Europa van onze klanten. Als onderdeel van het Compliance Team krijg jij je eigen (internationale) klanten, waarvoor jij een deel van de Europese btw-zaken afhandelt, en je een deel van de Europese btw-zaken coördineert met onze btw-partners. Deze komen bijvoorbeeld uit Spanje, Italië of Tsjechië. Bij het indienen van de Europese btw-aangiften word je geholpen door onze software, die precies uitrekent hoeveel btw de klant in ieder land verschuldigd is.

Een dag bij ons bestaat uit veel én veelzijdig klantcontact. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt voor jouw klanten, en je wordt indien nodig met vraagstukken bijgestaan door onze fiscalisten, accountmanagers of techafdeling.

Wij zoeken:

  • Iemand die verantwoordelijkheid neemt over zijn/haar taken;

  • Een zelfstandige houding;

  • Een flexibele instelling: in een een scale-up wil er namelijk nog wel eens wat veranderen;

  • Een actieve houding: we horen graag wat je denkt!

  • Iemand met basiskennis over btw;

Jij krijgt:

  • De flexibiliteit en verantwoordelijkheid om te werken waar en wanneer je wil;

  • Een salaris afhankelijk van achtergrond en ervaring (€2.500 - €3.200);

  • Een onbeperkt aantal vakantiedagen, uiteraard in overleg met je collega's;

  • Hands-on begeleiding in het Europese btw-systeem, gewoon door het te doen;

  • Een MacBook en iPhone van de zaak;

  • Interessante klanten met grote ambities en natuurlijk leuke collega's;

  • De mogelijkheid om mee te groeien binnen een snelgroeiende scale-up en jezelf persoonlijk te ontwikkelen;

  • De ruimte om jouw ideeën uit te voeren en het team te versterken;

  • Een tof kantoor in het centrum van Nijmegen, 15 minuten lopen van het CS (met gezellige bijkomende borrels). Werk je liever vanuit huis? Geen probleem! Kom je toch naar kantoor? Alleen maar gezellig. De keuze is aan jou.

Requirements

Je hebt/bent:

  • Een afgeronde MBO- of HBO-opleiding op het gebied van boekhouding, controlling, administratie of accounting;

  • Werkervaring is een pré, maar niet vereist;

  • Basiskennis over btw is een vereiste;

  • Secuur;

  • Flexibel;

  • Verantwoordelijk;

  • Communicatief sterk;

  • Leergierig;

  • De motivatie om een vraagstuk tot op de bodem uit te zoeken;

  • Geschikt voor werken in een scale-up: “it is gonna be a fun, but bumpy ride”;

  • Vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal en comfortabel met Engels.

raw.excerpt: PAXAFE is a pharmceutical logistics orchestration & decision intelligence SaaS platform that helps cold chain planning, logistics and quality teams consolidate their transportation data agnostically, digitize and automate product quality and lane qualification decisions, and operationalize prescriptive recommendations in the transportation network.
raw.description:
PAXAFE is a pharmceutical logistics orchestration & decision intelligence SaaS platform that helps cold chain planning, logistics and quality teams consolidate their transportation data agnostically, digitize and automate product quality and lane qualification decisions, and operationalize prescriptive recommendations in the transportation network.

​

Acting as the cold chain trust layer whose mission is to drive towards zero transportation waste, PAXAFE works with cold chain manufactures and service providers to reduce product loss, improve operational efficiencies and make more informed decisions in real-time.

PAXAFE's vision is to become the backend intelligence infrastructure that powers every temperature, time and value-sensitive shipment in the world.

PAXAFE is backed by great VCs (Framework Venture Partners, Ubiquity Ventures, Venture53, RoseCliff Ventures, etc.) and CVCs (Microsoft M12, Northwestern Mutual, Greenlight Re)

The Role

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (Implementation Lead) to drive successful deployments and long-term value for PAXAFE’s life sciences and logistics customers.

This role is fundamentally project management–driven. You will lead complex, cross-functional implementations for pharmaceutical and biotech customers, ensuring integrations, data flows, and operational processes come together seamlessly. You’ll act as the central point of coordination across customer stakeholders, internal teams, and technical systems.

You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be technically fluent — comfortable working with APIs, integration workflows, and data structures — and able to bridge the gap between business, operations, and engineering.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead end-to-end customer implementations across PAXAFE’s platform (Command Center, Lane Qualification, Auto Product Release, Risk Intelligence), with a strong focus on timeline, scope, and delivery quality.
  • Own project management responsibilities — building project plans, managing milestones, tracking risks, and ensuring accountability across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Translate pharmaceutical and supply chain requirements into structured implementation plans, aligning system capabilities with operational workflows.
  • Manage complex integration projects involving APIs, webhooks, IoT devices, and third-party systems (e.g., ERP, WMS, TMS, telematics).
  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers during implementation and expansion phases — ensuring clarity, momentum, and trust.
  • Drive ongoing customer programs as clients expand their control tower capabilities — managing new integrations, feature rollouts, and optimization initiatives.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to resolve blockers, refine requirements, and ensure scalable, high-quality deployments.
  • Capture and operationalize customer feedback to influence product roadmap and improve implementation playbooks.
  • Build repeatable processes and frameworks to scale implementations across a growing customer base.
  • Support training, documentation, and enablement for both customers and internal teams.

Who We’re Looking For

  • 6-15 years of experience in Project Management, Customer Success, or Implementation roles within SaaS, pharma, or supply chain environments.
  • Strong project management background — experienced in leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations with clear structure and execution discipline.
  • Domain experience in life sciences, pharma, biotech, or regulated supply chains is strongly preferred.
  • Technical fluency — understands APIs, JSON, system integrations, and data flows; comfortable reviewing API documentation and using tools like Postman.
  • Ability to translate between business and technical teams — ensuring alignment across operations, IT, and engineering.
  • Experience working with enterprise customers and regulated environments (GxP, compliance-driven processes) is a strong plus.
  • Highly organized and proactive — able to manage multiple workstreams and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working in a startup environment — adaptable, resourceful, and willing to build structure where it doesn’t yet exist.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Mission-driven impact: Help ensure the safe, compliant delivery of life-saving therapies and critical products worldwide
  • Project ownership: Lead high-visibility implementations with global pharmaceutical companies
  • Growth phase: Join at a pivotal stage where you can shape how Customer Success and Implementation scale
  • Collaborative environment: Work directly with Product, Engineering, and executive leadership
  • Cutting-edge technology: LLMs & Agentic AI | Azure | Python | Prismatic | Supabase | PostgreSQL | IoT
  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere (Central / Eastern US preferred)
  • Strong compensation & benefits: Competitive salary, equity, five weeks PTO, full healthcare coverage

Our Core Values

  • Create Magic: Deliver elegant solutions that exceed customer expectations
  • Own With Pride: Take accountability for outcomes and execution
  • Navigate With Intent: Make clear, strategic decisions
  • Think Deep, Act Fast: Balance thoughtful analysis with speed
  • Enjoy the Journey: Celebrate progress and wins
  • X-hibit Teamwork: Collaborate and support across teams
  • Tackle With Empathy: Understand before solving
