raw.description:
Senior Software Engineer - 3D Experiences Matterport

Job Description

CoStar Group is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights, and connections that improve their businesses and lives.

We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.

About Matterport:

Matterport is leading the digital transformation of the built world. Our groundbreaking spatial computing platform turns buildings into data, making every space more valuable and accessible. Millions of buildings in more than 170 countries have been transformed into immersive Matterport digital twins to improve every part of the building lifecycle from planning, construction, and operations to documentation, appraisal, and marketing.

About the Role:

As a SeniorSoftware Engineer on the 3D Experiences team at Matterport, a part of CoStar Group, you will be at the forefront of creating engaging user experiences and insights around Matterport’s 3D model technology. You will play a critical role in researching, developing, and implementing new features to our model viewer and editing platforms, maintaining existing feature sets, influencing code architecture, and impacting the way we build software together. You will work within a dynamic R&D environment, collaborating closely with fellow engineers, researchers, product, and design teams to translate groundbreaking ideas into tangible features that empower our users and expand the capabilities of our platform. Your work will be seen by 100’s of millions of viewers of Matterport models around the world and will be at the core of our customers' day-to-day workflows.

This position can be located remotely across the continental United States.

Responsibilities:

  • Implement new features for our 3D model viewer and editing tools utilizing Typescript, Three.js WebGL, and React.
  • You will develop new ways for our customers to interact, augment, and enhance their Matterport models with data.
  • Work with a cross-functional team of product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to define project requirements, explore technical feasibility, and deliver high-impact features.
  • Create working prototypes for new concepts, ideas, or platforms we want to explore.
  • Present concepts, progress, and delivered results to peers and stakeholders.
  • Advocate for new technical architecture and innovation.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field from an accredited, not for profit, in-person university or college
  • 5+ years of experience developing and maintaining user-friendly, performant web applications
  • Demonstrated proficiency working with Typescript, WebGL, and/or React
  • Experience working on a team, supporting teammates through peer review, and releasing software in a team environment with multiple work streams.
  • Versed and capable of solving problems in 3D space.
  • A track record of commitment to prior employers

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • 8+ years of experience working with Typescript, WebGL, and React building performant web applications.
  • Strong proficiency working with Three.js
  • Exposure to architectural patterns of large JavaScript applications.
  • Experience writing unit tests and mocking.
  • Experience shipping software in a large codebase to a large audience.
  • Experience working with Snowflake, Looker, and other advanced analytics tools.
  • Experience with mobile web-based application development.
  • Experience with AR/VR application development.

What’s in it for you?

When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed.

We offer you generous compensation and performance-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training, and tuition reimbursement.

Our benefits package includes (but is not limited to):

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage: Medical / Vision / Dental / Prescription Drug
  • Life, legal, and supplementary insurance
  • Virtual and in person mental health counseling services for individuals and family
  • Commuter and parking benefits
  • 401(K) retirement plan with matching contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • On-site fitness center and/or reimbursed fitness center membership costs (location dependent), with yoga studio, Pelotons, personal training, group exercise classes
  • Access to CoStar Group’s Employee Resource Groups
  • Complimentary gourmet coffee, tea, hot chocolate, fresh fruit, and other healthy snacks

This position offers an annual salary range from $124,000 - $210,000 determined by relevant skills and experience, in addition to a generous benefits plan.

We welcome all qualified candidates who are currently eligible to work full-time in the United States to apply.  However, please note that CoStar Group is not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

raw.description:
Company:

Qualcomm Germany GmbH

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Technical Standards Engineering

General Summary:

As a senior Technical Standards contributor and participant, you will work closely with internal and external partners to improve and evolve industry technical standards while representing Qualcomm as a delegate in standardization forums and industry organizations. Your responsibility will include understanding data center industry landscapes and competitors' strength and weaknesses, collaborating with internal partners to identify existing and emerging standards for Qualcomm to focus on, help review and guide internal product requirements and specifications for conformance with the standards, and working with attorneys to file patents that protect the novel IP aspects of any inventions.

The primary focus for this role is wired connectivity infrastructure involving high-speed optical and electrical SerDes standards for core data center infrastructure. This includes the implications of solving problems across photonics, packaging, materials science, and system architecture.

Technical Focus Areas

  • Direct experience with IEEE 802.3 and OIF. Aware of related developments in other data center interconnect standards ecosystems including OCI MSA, OCP, UEC, and UALink.
  • Deep understanding of 200G, 400G and forward-looking 800G/1.6T Ethernet rate evolution, including PAM4/PAM6 modulation, FEC, equalization, channel loss, BER targets and link-budget tradeoffs.
  • Knowledge of scale-up, scale-out and scale-across data center fabrics, including electrical copper reach limits, active electrical cables, linear pluggable optics, co-packaged optics, near-packaged optics, and optical module architectures.
  • Strong ecosystem credibility with data center silicon, optics, connector, cable, module, switch, NIC and hyperscaler stakeholders.
  • Ability to assess competitive technology directions, identify standards gaps, and shape specifications to support Qualcomm product and IP roadmap objectives.
  • Ability to translate hyperscaler, AI accelerator, switch silicon, and optical module requirements into practical SerDes, PHY, controller and standards engagement priorities.
  • Ability to check posted technical material for accuracy and prepare internal technical material and analysis.
  • Ability to establish and play a leading role in a potential future “800G Interest Group” (or similar name) as a means to promote Qualcomm credibility and thought leadership in Data Center connectivity.

Minimum Qualifications (per leveling description)

  • Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • 7+ years of experience in system design, validation, or related engineering roles
  • 2+ years of experience participating in technical standards bodies or industry organizations
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across teams and organizations
  • Effective communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in optical, SerDes and system design, modeling, validation, or test
  • 4+ years of active participation in standards organizations (e.g., IEEE, OCP, PCI-SIG or similar)
  • 5+ years of work experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership
  • 5+ years in a technical leadership role
  • Deep understanding of data center ecosystems, including enterprise, HPC, and hyperscale environments
  • Authored or co-authored contributions in IEEE, OCP or similar
  • Has implemented or influenced deployable OCP-compliant platforms
  • Experience designing and developing SerDes across full lifecycle (architecture, design, implementation, verification, validation, through manufacturing and silicon qualification)
  • Knowledge of global data center market dynamics and competitive landscape
  • Background in technical leadership roles with demonstrated impact
  • Familiarity with Qualcomm technologies and semiconductor platforms (preferred)
  • Established network within industry, standards bodies, or academia (preferred)
  • Excellent written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Willingness to travel as required

Keywords:

Optical, SerDes, Server, Systems, Semiconductor, Standards, Infrastructure, IEEE, PCIe, OCP, Data Center

Education Requirements:

Required: Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering

Preferred: Doctorate, Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering or related field

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

OR

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

*Global travel several times per year for standards organization forums.

*References to a particular number of years experience are for indicative purposes only. Applications from candidates with equivalent experience will be considered, provided that the candidate can demonstrate an ability to fulfill the principal duties of the role and possesses the required competencies.

Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may call Qualcomm's toll-free number foundhere. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. raw.description:
What is special about Lighthouse?

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals.   We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success.  We grow together and are stronger together.

What’s unique about this role?

Digital Forensics Consultants are responsible for providing forensic analysis services andconducting onsite and remotecollections of electronically stored information (ESI) from computers, mobile devices, networks, collaboration apps, cloud repositories, and various other media and data sources.Using state-of-the-art technology, they process and analyze data in support of forensic investigations and litigation and prepare compelling, detailed reports of their findings. Forensic Consultants may occasionally provide court testimony related to forensic analysis and data collection projects.

What will this person do?

  • Perform forensicallysoundonsite and remote collections of ESI from a wide variety of data sources, including but not limited to computers, mobile devices, hard drives, servers, external data storage devices, cloud data sources, and other digital media.
  • Perform forensic analysis of data in support of investigations and/or litigation.
  • Prepare detailed written forensic analysis reports, declarations, and related correspondence.
  • Provide written and/or oral testimony in court proceedings as necessary.
  • Assistclients and various Lighthouse business units in scoping new forensic projects to identify project requirements, recommend workflows, and develop timing and cost estimates.
  • Provideongoing andtimelyproject status updates.
  • Accurately track and log assigned data collections.
  • Conduct custodian interviews to identify relevant data sources.
  • Enter time and expenses into the appropriate billing system by prescribed deadlines.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you had the following:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalenttraining andexperience.
  • A person performing successfullyin this role typically hasfouror more years of experience in Digital Forensics consulting and client service.
  • Ability to describe complex technical concepts / ideas in non-technical terms, to less technical audiences
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to balance many priorities and to work under pressure while remaining calm.
  • Ability to be a team player and to collaborate with the various teams across the Company.
  • At least one security or digital forensics industrycertifications, such as CISSP,EnCE, CCE, CFCE, MCFE, or similar
  • Experience in the forensiccollection andanalysis of Windows, MacOS, iOS, and Android devices.
  • Experience in the forensic collection and analysis of cloud and enterprise data repositories (Microsoft Purview, Google Workspace, etc.)
  • Training, experience, and/orcertifications with forensic tools such as Axiom, EnCase, Forensic Toolkit, Cellebrite (Inseyetes, UFED, Physical Analyzer, Digital Inspector, Digital Collector),Verakey/Graykey, or open-source forensic tools.
  • Masteryofdata collection, preservation, and chain of custody principles and procedures.
  • Experience ininterfacing withclients and client partners to plan data collection and forensic analysis projects involving a wide variety of physical devices, network storage, cloud storage, and email platforms.
  • Understanding ofproject economics with the ability to work closely with forensic team leaders to provide project time and expense estimates and set appropriate project expectations.
  • Experience providingwritten reports and/or declarationsfor use inlegal proceedings.
  • Experience providing court testimony is a plus.
  • Programming, scripting, and/or database design experience is a plus.
  • Linux/UNIX experience is a plus.

Work Environment and Physical Demands

  • Duties are performed in a typical office environment while sitting at a desk or computer table.
  • Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material.
  • Duties may require being on-call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).
  • Duties will require occasional travel via automobile, airline, or other common passenger transport.
  • Travel requirements are dependent upon project needs. Travel is typically 10-30%.
  • Duties may occasionally be performed at a client’s facility.
  • Duties may require the ability tolift upto 50 lbs.

Job Area:

General Summary:

Job Description

Arduino is now part of the Qualcomm organisation!

PLEASE NOTE WE ARE FLEXIBLE ON LOCATION AND CAN CONSIDER CANDIDATES BASED ANYWHERE WITHIN EUROPE.

Arduino's mission is to enable people to enhance their lives through accessible open-source electronics and digital technologies. Since 2005, millions of people, from students to professional engineers, have used our platform to innovate across fields like smart homes, autonomous vehicles, and industrial automation.

We are now looking for a Business Development Account Manager to spearhead the international expansion of our e-commerce business. In this role, you will be the lead strategist and coordinator for entering new global markets, identifying the best technical solutions and localized strategies to bring Arduino products directly to more creators worldwide. You will act as a bridge between market opportunity and operational execution, ensuring our e-commerce footprint scale effectively across diverse regions.

Responsibilities

As the Business Development Account Manager for E-commerce, you will be responsible for the end-to-end strategy and deployment of our international digital sales channels. Your core duties will include:

  • Market Assessment: Identify and assess opportunities for international expansion by analyzing market potential, consumer trends, and regional demand for Arduino solutions.

  • Strategic Planning: Define the go-to-market strategy for new regions, including localized marketing approaches, and distribution logistics.

  • Solution Identification: Evaluate and select available e-commerce platforms and third-party solutions to ensure a seamless, localized user experience.

  • Stakeholder Coordination: coordinate multi-disciplinary teams to align on project milestones and deployment timelines.

  • Operational Execution: Coordinate the setup of new storefronts, ensuring compliance with local regulations and integration with internal systems. Manage the business in person or through local resources/agencies.

  • Performance Analysis: Monitor and report on the success of new market entries using KPIs, providing ROI analysis and data-driven recommendations to leadership.

  • User Experience Optimization: Plan and execute experiments, such as conversion tests and funnel optimizations, to maximize lead generation and sales performance.

  • Go to Market: define and lead go to market strategy, including marketing and advertising.

Preferred Minimum Qualifications / Skills

  • E-commerce Expertise: 5+ years of experience in managing and scaling e-commerce marketplaces (Amazon, Mercado Libre, FlipKart, Tmall, JD, etc.) across different countries and diverse cultures, preferably in Asia or LATAM.

  • Relationship Management: Ability to build rapport and influence internal stakeholders and external partners.

  • Project Management: Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to handle multiple international projects simultaneously with effective time management.

  • Analytical Mindset: Comfortable working with complex data to justify business decisions and adjust strategies based on performance metrics.

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Proactive & Remote-Ready: A self-starter who excels in unstructured environments and can operate effectively across different time zones.

  • Technical Affinity: A genuine interest in the Arduino ecosystem and the broader technology landscape.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related field.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.

OR

Associate's degree and 5+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.
OR
High School Diploma or equivalent and 7+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.

*Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

Bonus Points

  • Previous experience supporting global technology brands

  • Experience in a remote-first or multi-national work environment.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: A challenging path in a rapidly growing company with dedicated budgets for individual learning and training.

  • Flexibility: A remote-first culture with flexible working hours to support a healthy work-life balance.

  • Values: A mission-driven organization that encourages diversity, cultural exchange, and a modern work vision.

  • Meaningful Work: An opportunity to empower a global community of makers and professionals through accessible technology.

  • Compensation: A competitive salary and benefits package that values specialized experience.

Why You Should Join

At Arduino, we are leading the field of electronics and we value the unique combination of design and engineering that makes our platform well-loved. We offer a remote-first culture that supports work-life balance and a mission-driven organization that encourages diversity and continuous learning.

Company:

Qualcomm Germany GmbH

Job Area:

Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Business Development - SIP

General Summary:

At Qualcomm, we invent breakthrough technologies that transform how the world connects, computes, and communicates. For over 35 years, Qualcomm has been the world’s leading wireless technology innovator and the driving force behind the development, launch, and expansion of 5G. We perfected processing for the smartphone, and now encompass many different verticals and products. From compute to automotive to gaming—you’ll find Snapdragon branded technologies making a difference. In 2023, we launched Snapdragon X Series - the most powerful, intelligent, and efficient processor for Windows in its class. Designed for this next era of modern AI computing, these cutting-edge devices deliver unparalleled performance, multi-day battery life, and advanced AI capabilities, redefining the personal computing experience.

Job Description: As a EMEA Channel GTM Manager in Germany you will engage across a select portfolio of Distributors and leading Channel Partners to define strategic marketing programs and GTM plans that drive market awareness, preference, and demand for Snapdragon-based compute devices in the Commercial Channel. You will collaborate with channel counterparts including Marketing, PAMs and OEMs to develop and implement omni-channel marketing programs, joint OEM campaigns, demand generation initiatives, pipeline acceleration activities, seller enablement motions as well as joint PR and event marketing that deliver significant ROI and meet performance goals.

This role requires a strategic thinker with excellent relationship-building skills and a strong understanding of marketing channels and tactics as well as a comprehensive knowledge of the IT industry – with strong focus on the Commercial Compute Channel. This is a fast-paced role where you will work with multiple teams across various time zones. The ideal candidate has in-depth knowledge of the regional market and expertise in driving customers down the marketing funnel. They possess extensive experience in developing and managing marketing programs and GTM plans across multiple partners and have a proven track record in scaling sales enablement efforts to drive partner awareness and advocacy.

Key Responsibilities:

Channel Relationship & Partner Management

  • Develop and support execution of quarterly GTM plans in collaboration with Commercial Channel Partners and Account Management team to enhance brand visibility, customer engagement, and drive revenue growth.
  • Foster and expand relationships with the Partner’s Marketing, OEM, and PAMs, and lead regularly scheduled meetings to ensure campaign and program alignment and execution.
  • Articulate the Snapdragon value proposition to the Partners Marketing and PAMs to ensure the benefits of Snapdragon resonate via the various channel programs.
  • Work with the Partner’s Marketing team to adapt marketing material to fit their audience - inclusive of email, social, banner ads, videos, content syndication, etc.
  • Manage quarterly Marketing investment plans for GTM related activities ensuring ROI.
  • Manage the approval process for Partner assets to ensure all Partner-created content and assets comply with Qualcomm brand guidelines and GTM messaging.

OEM

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration to strengthen OEM partnerships at country level and ensure alignment on all regional GTM activities.
  • Build relationships with Partner OEM managers to ensure cohesive communication and alignment between the Channel Partner, Qualcomm, and the OEMs.
  • Identify relevant cross-collaboration activities to drive the sellout of Snapdragon-based devices, ensuring Snapdragon is represented appropriately in marketing materials.
  • Leverage OEM relationships to gain regional insights on products and markets and build a credible knowledge base within the organization.

HQ/EMEA

  • Collaborate with the HQ Commercial teams and the regional Account Management team to understand the Snapdragon compute value proposition and product roadmap to articulate this messaging to Channel partners.
  • Provide regular updates to the worldwide and regional leadership teams on Partner GTM plans, activities, and success metrics, working closely with the regional Account Team and Channel Partners to measure the ROI of MDF investment.
  • Work with the regional Account Team to understand and prioritize partnerships based on defined targets and align GTM plans to strategic focus in the region.
  • Build and maintain a strong network with the HQ Business, Marketing, PR, Social, Digital, Channel Training, and Brand teams to ensure that brand identity, messaging, and processes are seamlessly integrated into our regional go-to-market strategies and tactics.

Campaign Management

  • Develop and implement marketing campaigns, strategies, and tactics to promote the sellout of Windows on Snapdragon-based devices in collaboration with OEMs and Channel Partners.
  • Identify key verticals, target audiences, and KPIs for each campaign to track and measure success.
  • Work closely with Channel Partners to identify the sales funnel and lead qualification flow, ensuring relevant leads are nurtured by Channel Sales teams.
  • Collect and report on post-campaign metrics from Channel Partners to monitor the performance of spend.

Event Management

  • Collaborate with Channel Partners and OEMs to identify relevant tradeshows and customer-facing events that resonate with their audience and incorporate these into the GTM plans.
  • Develop a comprehensive event plan in collaboration with the Channel Marketing teams and their agency, covering aspects such as timings, venue, build cost, content, invitations, and attendee list.
  • Coordinate with the Qualcomm Marketing and PDM teams to identify and integrate relevant Qualcomm content for presentations to drive the Snapdragon value proposition.
  • Host pre-event kick-offs and post-event debriefs, and report on post-event metrics to track ROI.

Skills/Experience

  • 8 + years Commercial Channel and Marketing experience ideally from the compute industry.
  • Strong understanding of how the Commercial Channel and OEMs operate and sell, possess a deep understanding of the marketing funnel and tactics, as well as lead generation and nurturing tactics and tools.
  • Experience in negotiating and managing MDF Programs.
  • Skilled in defining and executing B2B and Channel programs to effectively drive customers down the funnel.
  • Creative problem solving with strong analytical and project management skills.
  • Ability to communicate and evangelize both internally and externally.
  • Proven experience in working on new projects and establishing new ways of working.
  • Comfortable driving cross-functional team alignment to create a comprehensive plan, identifying dependencies and critical issues/paths.
  • Experience in analyzing and reporting on the effectiveness of marketing programs and GTM plans and adjusting strategies as needed within established KPIs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of Commercial Channel and marketing experience ideally from the compute industry.
  • Master's degree in business or technology is preferred.
  • Business level English and German is required, additional languages a plus.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to build trusting, collaborative relationships and rapport with senior business stakeholders & Channel Partners.
  • Strong capability to convey information clearly and accurately with great credibility.
  • Highly organized, resourceful, and adaptable.

What's on Offer

Apart from working in an open, relaxed and collaborative space, you will enjoy:

  • Friendly and collaborative working environment
  • Salary, stock and performance related bonus

· Maternity/Paternity Leave

· Employee stock purchase scheme

· Matching pension scheme

· Education Assistance

  • Life, Medical, Income and Travel Insurance

General Summary:

Job Description

Arduino is now part of the Qualcomm organisation!

PLEASE NOTE WE ARE FLEXIBLE ON LOCATION AND CAN CONSIDER CANDIDATES BASED ANYWHERE WITHIN EUROPE.

Arduino's mission is to enable people to enhance their lives through accessible open-source electronics and digital technologies. Since 2005, millions of people, from students to professional engineers, have used our platform to innovate across fields like smart homes, autonomous vehicles, and industrial automation.

We are now looking for a Business Development Account Manager to spearhead the international expansion of our e-commerce business. In this role, you will be the lead strategist and coordinator for entering new global markets, identifying the best technical solutions and localized strategies to bring Arduino products directly to more creators worldwide. You will act as a bridge between market opportunity and operational execution, ensuring our e-commerce footprint scale effectively across diverse regions.

Responsibilities

As the Business Development Account Manager for E-commerce, you will be responsible for the end-to-end strategy and deployment of our international digital sales channels. Your core duties will include:

  • Market Assessment: Identify and assess opportunities for international expansion by analyzing market potential, consumer trends, and regional demand for Arduino solutions.

  • Strategic Planning: Define the go-to-market strategy for new regions, including localized marketing approaches, and distribution logistics.

  • Solution Identification: Evaluate and select available e-commerce platforms and third-party solutions to ensure a seamless, localized user experience.

  • Stakeholder Coordination: coordinate multi-disciplinary teams to align on project milestones and deployment timelines.

  • Operational Execution: Coordinate the setup of new storefronts, ensuring compliance with local regulations and integration with internal systems. Manage the business in person or through local resources/agencies.

  • Performance Analysis: Monitor and report on the success of new market entries using KPIs, providing ROI analysis and data-driven recommendations to leadership.

  • User Experience Optimization: Plan and execute experiments, such as conversion tests and funnel optimizations, to maximize lead generation and sales performance.

  • Go to Market: define and lead go to market strategy, including marketing and advertising.

Preferred Minimum Qualifications / Skills

  • E-commerce Expertise: 5+ years of experience in managing and scaling e-commerce marketplaces (Amazon, Mercado Libre, FlipKart, Tmall, JD, etc.) across different countries and diverse cultures, preferably in Asia or LATAM.

  • Relationship Management: Ability to build rapport and influence internal stakeholders and external partners.

  • Project Management: Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to handle multiple international projects simultaneously with effective time management.

  • Analytical Mindset: Comfortable working with complex data to justify business decisions and adjust strategies based on performance metrics.

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Proactive & Remote-Ready: A self-starter who excels in unstructured environments and can operate effectively across different time zones.

  • Technical Affinity: A genuine interest in the Arduino ecosystem and the broader technology landscape.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related field.

Additional Job Description

Bonus Points

  • Previous experience supporting global technology brands

  • Experience in a remote-first or multi-national work environment.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: A challenging path in a rapidly growing company with dedicated budgets for individual learning and training.

  • Flexibility: A remote-first culture with flexible working hours to support a healthy work-life balance.

  • Values: A mission-driven organization that encourages diversity, cultural exchange, and a modern work vision.

  • Meaningful Work: An opportunity to empower a global community of makers and professionals through accessible technology.

  • Compensation: A competitive salary and benefits package that values specialized experience.

Why You Should Join

At Arduino, we are leading the field of electronics and we value the unique combination of design and engineering that makes our platform well-loved. We offer a remote-first culture that supports work-life balance and a mission-driven organization that encourages diversity and continuous learning.

General Summary:

The Principal Engineer, Verification (CI/CD & Embedded HW) is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing, scaling, and hardening CI/CD infrastructure and verification systems that validate Qualcomm’s AI Software stack—including QNN HTP, QAIRT, toolchains, kernels, and embedded runtime components.

REMOTE based is possible for this role.

This role is deeply technical and hands‑on: you will build large‑scale automated pipelines, integrate embedded hardware (DSP, NPU) test execution, drive target‑based regression infrastructure, and ensure efficient, reliable, and high‑signal validation at scale.

You can apply past experience managing large CI/CD pipelines to quickly target issues that arise to a software and/or hardware level. New Position

Key Responsibilities (IC‑Focused):

CI/CD Infrastructure Architecture & Scaling

  • Architect and scale large‑distributed CI/CD systems with high throughput and low flakiness.
  • Design automated workflows: build, package, deploy, flash, run, log‑collection, triage, dashboarding.
  • Develop scheduling/orchestration layers for thousands of HW‑based regression tests.
  • Implement monitoring, telemetry, and automated mitigation for CI stability.

Embedded Hardware Validation & Automation

  • Develop embedded target test frameworks across DSP/NPU.
  • Automate flashing, provisioning, power/reset, and new chipset bring‑up.
  • Design hardware‑in‑loop validation for stability, thermal, long‑run correctness, and performance.

Test Strategy, Coverage Expansion & Signal Improvement

  • Own coverage strategy for throughput, correctness, memory behavior, and runtime scheduling.
  • Develop automated triage signals and failure classification systems.
  • Eliminate flakiness and nondeterminism in HW test environments.

Open‑Source & Internal Pipeline Ownership

  • Maintain CI/verification pipelines for internal and open‑source projects.
  • Enforce PR gating, reproducible builds, artifact management, and API correctness.

Cross‑Functional Influence

  • Influence DevOps, firmware, and platform teams using data‑driven insights.
  • Lead technical deep‑dives on CI and embedded HW failures.
  • Align infrastructure capabilities with program milestones and customer requirements.

Documentation & Process Engineering

  • Produce high‑quality documentation for CI architecture, HW frameworks, and best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement and streamline reproducible HW testing workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in CI/CD engineering, verification, embedded systems, or runtime/toolchain development.
  • Expertise designing/scaling CI/CD (Buildkite, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Deep experience integrating embedded hardware into automated pipelines.
  • Background in firmware flashing, device provisioning, power/reset automation, and board‑farm debugging.
  • Strong scripting/programming in Python, Bash, C/C++.
  • Experience maintaining open‑source verification pipelines.
  • Strong debugging across runtime/driver/inference layers.
  • Ability to influence cross‑functional engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Qualcomm AI stack (QNN, QAIRT, SNPE).
  • Experience with heterogeneous compute validation (DSP/GPU/CPU/NPU).
  • Background in silicon bring‑up or hardware‑in‑loop systems.
  • Experience with large device‑farm operation and automation.

Success Indicators

  • Highly stable, scalable CI/CD pipelines with reduced failures/flakiness.
  • Faster regression turnaround and increased throughput.
  • Strong embedded target coverage with reproducible signals.
  • Positive feedback from global engineering teams.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 8+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 7+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

raw.description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies International Ltd

Job Area:

Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Sales - Sales Incentive Plan

General Summary:

Arduino is now part of the Qualcomm organisation!

PLEASE NOTE WE ARE FLEXIBLE ON LOCATION AND CAN CONSIDER CANDIDATES BASED ANYWHERE WITHIN EUROPE.

Arduino's mission is to enable people to enhance their lives through accessible open-source electronics and digital technologies. Since 2005, millions of people, from students to professional engineers, have used our platform to innovate across fields like smart homes, autonomous vehicles, and industrial automation.

We are now looking for a Business Development Account Manager to spearhead the international expansion of our e-commerce business. In this role, you will be the lead strategist and coordinator for entering new global markets, identifying the best technical solutions and localized strategies to bring Arduino products directly to more creators worldwide. You will act as a bridge between market opportunity and operational execution, ensuring our e-commerce footprint scale effectively across diverse regions.

Responsibilities

As the Business Development Account Manager for E-commerce, you will be responsible for the end-to-end strategy and deployment of our international digital sales channels. Your core duties will include:

  • Market Assessment: Identify and assess opportunities for international expansion by analyzing market potential, consumer trends, and regional demand for Arduino solutions.

  • Strategic Planning: Define the go-to-market strategy for new regions, including localized marketing approaches, and distribution logistics.

  • Solution Identification: Evaluate and select available e-commerce platforms and third-party solutions to ensure a seamless, localized user experience.

  • Stakeholder Coordination: coordinate multi-disciplinary teams to align on project milestones and deployment timelines.

  • Operational Execution: Coordinate the setup of new storefronts, ensuring compliance with local regulations and integration with internal systems. Manage the business in person or through local resources/agencies.

  • Performance Analysis: Monitor and report on the success of new market entries using KPIs, providing ROI analysis and data-driven recommendations to leadership.

  • User Experience Optimization: Plan and execute experiments, such as conversion tests and funnel optimizations, to maximize lead generation and sales performance.

  • Go to Market: define and lead go to market strategy, including marketing and advertising.

Preferred Minimum Qualifications / Skills

  • E-commerce Expertise: 5+ years of experience in managing and scaling e-commerce marketplaces (Amazon, Mercado Libre, FlipKart, Tmall, JD, etc.) across different countries and diverse cultures, preferably in Asia or LATAM.

  • Relationship Management: Ability to build rapport and influence internal stakeholders and external partners.

  • Project Management: Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to handle multiple international projects simultaneously with effective time management.

  • Analytical Mindset: Comfortable working with complex data to justify business decisions and adjust strategies based on performance metrics.

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Proactive & Remote-Ready: A self-starter who excels in unstructured environments and can operate effectively across different time zones.

  • Technical Affinity: A genuine interest in the Arduino ecosystem and the broader technology landscape.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or a related field.

Bonus Points

  • Previous experience supporting global technology brands

  • Experience in a remote-first or multi-national work environment.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: A challenging path in a rapidly growing company with dedicated budgets for individual learning and training.

  • Flexibility: A remote-first culture with flexible working hours to support a healthy work-life balance.

  • Values: A mission-driven organization that encourages diversity, cultural exchange, and a modern work vision.

  • Meaningful Work: An opportunity to empower a global community of makers and professionals through accessible technology.

  • Compensation: A competitive salary and benefits package that values specialized experience.

Why You Should Join

At Arduino, we are leading the field of electronics and we value the unique combination of design and engineering that makes our platform well-loved. We offer a remote-first culture that supports work-life balance and a mission-driven organization that encourages diversity and continuous learning.

*References to a particular number of years experience are for indicative purposes only. Applications from candidates with equivalent experience will be considered, provided that the candidate can demonstrate an ability to fulfill the principal duties of the role and possesses the required competencies.

Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found here. Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. (Keep in mind that this email address is used to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries).

Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law.

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies:Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Qualcomm does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Qualcomm employees or any other company location. Qualcomm is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

If you would like more information about this role, please contactQualcomm Careers.

Atenção: Por se tratar de um Banco de Talentos, não temos previsão de quando a posição será aberta. Por isso continue atualizando seu perfil e atente-se aos canais de comunicação. Assim que tivermos qualquer novidade você será acionado/a.

Informações adicionais

Local de Trabalho: Santa Rita do Sapucaí - MG.

O Inatel

O Instituto Nacional de Telecomunicações é um centro de ensino, pesquisa e desenvolvimento de tecnologias, criado em 1965. Foi a primeira instituição de ensino superior de Engenharia de Telecomunicações do Brasil. Desde a fundação, o Inatel caminha junto às importantes decisões no que diz respeito a telecomunicações, tecnologia da informação, informática e todos os ramos da tecnologia.

A instituição possui mais de 800 colaboradores alocados em Santa Rita do Sapucaí, sul de Minas Gerais, região conhecida nacional e internacionalmente como o “Vale da Eletrônica” e em outras cidades do Brasil de forma remota.

Áreas de atuação:

  • Ensino – atualmente oferece sete cursos de graduação - Engenharia Biomédica, Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Software e Engenharia de Telecomunicações; além de pós-graduação lato sensu, cursos a distância e ainda Mestrado e Doutorado em Telecomunicações.
  • Pesquisa - A instituição desenvolve pesquisas nas áreas de Comunicações Ópticas e Sem Fio, Redes e Rádios Cognitivos e Redes de Computadores e mais recentemente, iniciou estudos sobre o acesso à Internet banda larga sem fio, enlaces de comunicação via satélite, radioenlaces de longo alcance e grande capacidade e, principalmente, redes de comunicações móveis de 5ª Geração, por meio da implantação do Centro de Referência em Radiocomunicações (CRR), projeto entre Inatel, FINEP, MiniCom e Funttel.
  • Desenvolvimento de tecnologias - além de formar profissionais, o Inatel transfere tecnologia ao mercado nas áreas de desenvolvimento de Software, Hardware, Educação Continuada, Consultoria e Calibração de Equipamentos. Possui parcerias com empresas de grande porte nacionais e multinacionais.

title: Principal Cloud Database Engineer
description: We are seeking a Principal Cloud Database Engineer (GCP & AI) to drive architecture, engineering, and innovation across enterprise-scale database platforms.

raw.title: Principal Cloud Database Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a Principal Cloud Database Engineer (GCP & AI) to drive architecture, engineering, and innovation across enterprise-scale database platforms.
raw.description:
We are seeking a Principal Cloud Database Engineer (GCP & AI) to drive architecture, engineering, and innovation across enterprise-scale database platforms. This role will lead modernization efforts using Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, and Spanner while integrating AI-driven capabilities into database operations and data platforms.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in relational database systems and cloud architecture with hands-on exposure to AI/ML technologies to enable intelligent, automated, and scalable data solutions.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead architecture design and engineering for GCP relational database platforms (Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, Cloud SQL for SQL Server, AlloyDB, Spanner).

  • Define and implement enterprise database standards aligned with security, scalability, and performance best practices.

  • Drive modernization initiatives including database migrations to GCP using tools such as DMS, Striim and migration frameworks.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Design highly available, resilient, and cost-optimized database solutions on GCP.

  • Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform.

  • Enable secure connectivity patterns (IAM, VPC, Private Service Access, Private Service Connect, serverless integrations).

  • Lead Cloud Databases financial accounting, performance tuning, capacity planning, and database reliability engineering.

AI & Data Innovation

  • Integrate AI/ML capabilities into database platforms (e.g., MCP, data agents, context engineering, anomaly detection, query optimization).

  • Consult with application teams to enable data pipelines for AI/ML workloads.

  • Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted database operations and automation solutions.

  • Drive initiatives on AI-enabled observability and self-healing systems.

Operational Excellence

  • Establish best practices for backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and compliance.

  • Define monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies for database services.

  • Lead database governance and continuous cost optimization initiatives.

  • Provide CUD evaluation and recommendations.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Mentor Summer Interns, Ford College Graduates, Cloud engineers and Database Specialists; act as Subject Matter Expert for GCP relational databases.

  • Partner with application, DevOps, and architecture teams to deliver scalable solutions.

  • Influence platform strategy and roadmap for database and AI adoption.

  • Advocate with GCP product and engineering teams to enhance/mature GCP database services.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field.

  • 10+ years of experience in relational database engineering (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, AlloyDB or Spanner).

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with GCP, especially:

    • Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL and/or Cloud SQL for SQL Server

    • AlloyDB

    • Cloud Spanner

  • Strong expertise in:

    • Database platform automation, design, indexing, and performance tuning

    • Backup/recovery and high availability architectures

    • Migration strategies and tools (e.g., DMS, Striim, replication tools)

  • Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and IaC.

  • Programming experience (Terraform, Python, Java, or Go).

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

• Immediate medical, dental, and prescription drug coverage

• Flexible family care, parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more

• Vehicle discount program for employees and family members, and management leases

• Tuition assistance

• Established and active employee resource groups

• Paid time off for individual and team community service

• A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day

• Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

For a detailed look at our benefits, click here:Benefit Summary

This position is a salary grade8.

This position is a salary grade 8 and ranges from $115,000-$192,900.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.

*Visa Sponsorship is not provided for this role*

Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, If you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1-888-336-0660.

raw.description:
Vaga para Product Manager Sênior na Pulsus

Somos apaixonados por tecnologia e por entregar resultados para nossos clientes!

Valorizamos pessoas acostumadas a resolver problemas complexos e transformar desafios em soluções escaláveis.

Nossa plataforma é robusta e envolve muitos conceitos técnicos, conectando recursos de EMM (Enterprise Mobility Management), telemetria, eficiência e segurança nos mais variados tipos de dispositivos, para entregar valor em um ambiente B2B de alto impacto.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Manager Sênior, que será a ponte entre a estratégia de negócios e a execução tática e operacional do produto, moldando o futuro da nossa plataforma SaaS e ajudando a escalar ainda mais o nosso negócio.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Responsabilidade, comprometimento e ética nas suas atitudes e decisões;
  • Sede por conhecimento e compartilhar isso com a equipe;
  • Abertura para mudanças e intencionalidade: tudo o que fazemos é direcionado para gerar resultados de negócio;
  • E por fim, aproveitar a jornada e criar conexões com um time colaborativo e muito dedicado!

Se você se identifica com estes desafios e expectativas, vem com a gente!

Como Product Manager Sênior, você fará parte do time de produtos da Pulsus, com as seguintes atribuições principais:

  • Definir a estratégia e roadmap dos produtos sob sua gestão, sempre alinhados aos objetivos estratégicos da companhia e os movimentos de mercado;
  • Analisar dados, fazer pesquisas de mercado e entrevistar clientes para buscar novas alavancas de crescimento para o negócio;
  • Definir hipóteses e priorizá-las de forma estratégica, equilibrando entregas de valor ao cliente e manutenção da saúde técnica da plataforma, baseando suas decisões em evidências sólidas;
  • Ser o facilitador entre clientes, parceiros, áreas de negócios e demais stakeholders internos, traduzindo requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e acionáveis;
  • Participar ativamente em cerimônias ágeis, promovendo colaboração entre tecnologia, UX e negócios, e contribuindo para que o time esteja alinhado e focado nos objetivos;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os tech leads para avaliar viabilidade técnica e mitigar riscos das soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de novos recursos e melhorias, desde a concepção, até a implementação, lançamento e monitoramento de resultados;
  • Definir, alinhar e executar estratégias de go-to-market (definição de ICP, proposta de valor, posicionamento, narrativa, empacotamento, precificação, canais de vendas e etc) de novas features e/ou produtos;
  • Acompanhar e reportar resultados dos seus produtos e lançamentos (ex.: uso, engajamento, performance, escalabilidade, receita, custos e etc);
  • Auxiliar na melhoria contínua de processos e alinhamentos com outras áreas da empresa para gerar eficiência nos fluxos de Discovery e Delivery.

Para essa posição precisamos que você tenha as seguintes experiências/conhecimentos:

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager em produtos SaaS, preferencialmente em ambientes B2B ou plataformas de gestão (ex.: MDM, ERP, CRM e etc);
  • Compreensão robusta sobre negócios (métricas, operações, mercado, oportunidades e estratégias), correlacionando suas decisões de produto com o impacto no crescimento da empresa;
  • Habilidade de analisar e resolver problemas de forma iterativa e rápida, traduzindo as necessidades dos clientes em requisitos claros e específicos de produto;
  • Capacidade de dominar e discutir riscos técnicos com o time de engenharia;
  • Sagacidade para pesquisar, estudar e aprender conceitos, soluções, ferramentas e tecnologias novas;
  • Habilidade de influenciar positivamente a equipe (mesmo não atuando como liderança direta), transmitindo os níveis de importância e urgência necessários para que as entregas sejam realizadas nos prazos acordados;
  • Capacidade de instrumentar, coletar e extrair conclusões de dados complexos;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise de experiência do usuário (Ex: Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude e etc);
  • Experiência com tecnologias de inteligência artificial (LLMs) evibe coding;
  • Forte habilidade de organização, documentação e comunicação para alinhamento com stakeholders em um ambiente 100% remoto.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação em parceria com o iFood Benefícios
  • Clube iFood sem mensalidade
  • Plano de Saúde, opções:
  • SulAmérica - Clássico Apartamento ou Especial 100 R1

  • Plano odontológico, opções:
  • SulAmérica
  • Bradesco Odonto

  • Participação nos Resultados (PPR) de acordo com o atingimento das metas da empresa
  • Day off de aniversário

﻿

  • Wellhub (Gympass):Plataforma de academias e apps relacionados à saúde física, emocional e bem-estar
  • Starbem:Plataforma com parceiros de cuidados com a saúde e bem-estar. Atendimentos de psicologia, nutricionistas e médicos por consulta online

raw.description:
Position Summary

Link Title is seeking an experienced, licensedUtah Escrow Officerto join our team on apart-time basis. This role is ideal for an experienced escrow professional looking for a flexible schedule while continuing to utilize their expertise in residential real estate closings.You'llbe responsible for managing escrow transactions from opening through funding and disbursement, ensuring every closing is completed accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with all applicable regulations.

Due to Utah licensing requirements, candidates must hold an active Utah Escrow Officer License and may only be affiliated with a maximum of two companies.

What You'll Do

  • Manage residential escrow transactions from file opening through closing.
  • Prepare and review settlement statements for accuracy.
  • Coordinate with lenders, attorneys, title staff, and other parties to facilitate successful closings.
  • Process escrow disbursements, wire transfers, and trust account transactions.
  • Ensure all funding conditions and closing requirements have been satisfied prior to disbursement.
  • Maintain accurate transaction files and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with escrow account reconciliations and audit requests.
  • Follow all federal, state, and company compliance requirements.
  • Adhere to fraud prevention procedures, including wire verification protocols.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required

  • Active Utah Escrow Officer License in good standing.
  • Minimum of5 yearsof combined title examination and escrow closing experience.
  • Experience handling residential real estate transactions from opening through closing.
  • Strong knowledge of escrow funding, settlement statements, and trust account management.
  • Ability to meet Utah licensing affiliation requirements (maximum of two company affiliations).
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

Preferred

  • Experience working with lenders and mortgage servicers.
  • Experience in multi-state title operations.
  • Familiarity with title production and escrow software.

Why This Role?

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced escrow professional seeking apart-time, flexible positionwith a growing national title company. You'll have the opportunity to apply your expertise while enjoying a schedule that offers greater work-life balance.

About Link Title

Founded by industry veteransAuvese PashaandShashank Cukkemane, Link Title was built to modernize the title industry.

After more than 25 years of seeing lenders struggle with poor communication, missed deadlines, and outdated processes, we created a company focused on transparency, technology, and exceptional service. Today, Link Title serves lenders, servicers, and homebuyers nationwide with one simple promise—you'll always know where your file stands.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Link Title is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
Intelex is looking for a Senior Product Manager, AI and Analytics to join our growing AI team and help shape the future of intelligence-powered EHSQ software. In this role, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for AI and analytics capabilities across the Intelex platform—spanning structured data transformation, embedded AI features, and the analytics experiences that turn EHSQ data into organizational insight.

You will work at the intersection of customer value, data architecture, and cutting-edge AI—translating complex enterprise needs into clear, prioritized roadmaps and working hand-in-hand with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to bring those roadmaps to life. The ideal candidate blends strong analytical thinking with a deep passion for AI product development and brings communication skills to align cross-functional stakeholders and represent our product strategy externally.

Responsibilities and Deliverables

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and maintain the product roadmap for AI and analytics capabilities, balancing near-term customer value with long-term platform differentiation.

  • Translate business objectives, market signals, and customer research into a prioritized backlog with clear goals, success metrics, and release milestones.

  • Develop and communicate a compelling product vision for how AI—including LLMs, Auto-Structure, AI Lens, and agentic workflows—will transform how EHSQ professionals work.

  • Partner with the VP of Data Analytics, Architecture & AI to align AI product investments with company strategy and Fortive Business System priorities.

  • Identify opportunities to leverage Intelex’s unique cross-industry EHSQ data as a strategic moat, and build products that capitalize on it.

Customer & Market Discovery

  • Conduct ongoing customer discovery—through interviews, advisory councils, and collaboration with sales and customer success—to deeply understand EHSQ workflows and unmet needs.

  • Analyze usage data, NPS feedback, and support signals to identify friction points and validate hypotheses before committing to development.

  • Track the competitive landscape across EHSQ software, EHS AI point solutions, and horizontal AI platforms to surface gaps and positioning opportunities.

  • Partner with marketing on positioning, messaging, and analyst relations (e.g., Verdantix, Gartner) for AI and analytics features.

Delivery & Execution

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of AI and analytics features—from writing clear PRDs and acceptance criteria through sprint planning, launch, and post-release iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering leads, AI Solution Architects, and UX designers to make sound build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions and ensure technical feasibility.

  • Define instrumentation and analytics strategies so new AI features are measurable from day one; monitor adoption, quality, and outcome metrics post-launch.

  • Manage dependencies across squads and proactively surface risks to delivery timelines.

  • Support customer onboarding and enablement by working with the services team to define configuration guides, training materials, and rollout playbooks for AI capabilities.

Stakeholder Engagement & Enablement

  • Serve as the internal product authority on AI and analytics—enabling sales, presales, and customer success teams with competitive positioning, demo narratives, and feature deep-dives.

  • Present roadmap updates, business cases, and launch readiness reviews to senior leadership, including the CPTO and executive team.

  • Represent the voice of the customer in architecture and governance reviews, ensuring AI design decisions preserve trust, explainability, and regulatory compliance.

  • Contribute to Intelex’s external AI narrative—including customer-facing trust and governance documentation, AI pricing strategy, and partner/ecosystem communications.

Organizational Alignment

Reports to the VP of Data Analytics, Architecture and AI

Qualifications

Skills & Work Traits

  • Exceptional communicator—able to translate ambiguous AI concepts into crisp business value for executives, customers, and engineers alike.

  • Customer-obsessed with a bias for discovery before solutioning; comfortable sitting with ambiguity and structuring it into actionable plans.

  • Highly collaborative and cross-functional—builds trust quickly with engineering, design, data, sales, and services partners.

  • Analytically rigorous: uses data to drive prioritization decisions, measure outcomes, and tell compelling product stories.

  • Strong product instincts for what makes AI features trustworthy, useful, and adoptable in enterprise software contexts.

  • Self-directed and proactive, with the organizational discipline to manage multiple roadmap threads simultaneously and keep stakeholders aligned.

  • Comfortable representing the company externally—with customers, analysts, and partners—on AI product strategy and roadmap.

  • Leader who embraces the Fortive Business System and applies continuous improvement thinking to product processes.

Product & Domain Competencies

  • Deep familiarity with enterprise SaaS product management, including PRD writing, agile delivery, roadmap governance, and go-to-market execution.

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML product concepts—including LLMs, RAG, structured data extraction, classification models, and agentic workflows—sufficient to engage credibly with engineering and make sound trade-off decisions.

  • Experience defining and tracking analytics product metrics (e.g., feature adoption, model accuracy, time-to-insight) and working with data teams to instrument and monitor them.

  • Familiarity with cloud data stacks (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure) and BI/analytics tooling (e.g., QuickSight, Sisense, or equivalent) at a conceptual level.

  • Exposure to AI governance, data privacy, and responsible AI principles as they apply to enterprise software products.

  • Experience in or passion for EHS, quality, sustainability, or regulated-industry verticals is a strong asset.

Experience

Required:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI, data, or analytics products in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Demonstrated track record of taking AI or data-driven features from discovery through launch and measuring their business impact.

  • Experience working directly with data science, ML engineering, or AI architecture teams and translating technical constraints into clear product decisions.

  • Strong command of agile methodologies and experience managing a backlog across multiple concurrent workstreams.

Preferred:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including at least one senior or lead PM role.

  • Experience in enterprise EHSQ, ERP, compliance, or related regulated-industry software.

  • Background in or exposure to data product management, including working with structured and unstructured data transformation pipelines.

  • Familiarity with AI platform economics, usage-based pricing models, or AI add-on packaging in enterprise SaaS.

Education

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline. Product management certifications (e.g., Pragmatic Institute, AIPMM) or AI/ML fundamentals certifications are a plus.

Other Requirements

Please note that this role requires a satisfactory Criminal Background Check and Public Safety Verification.

As a Strategic Partners Account Manager, you will own and grow a portfolio of Accruent’s most important partner-led accounts. This is a revenue-owning role focused on driving pipeline, executing deals, and scaling the performance of Accruent’s partner ecosystem.

You are not a supporting resource to a sales team-you are the primary owner of the partner-led sales motion. You will lead everything from pipeline creation and deal strategy through closing opportunities and managing renewals, while enabling partners to sell and scale Accruent solutions.

The Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) Program Management Office is seeking a Program Manager to drive business growth by applying program management skills in the development of innovative, software-enabled digital health solutions.

Reporting to the FHS Director of the PMO, you will drive process discipline by leading cross‑functional, geographically dispersed program teams through scoping, resource planning, target setting, and accountability across application software, data/AI workstreams, and supporting functions. The role requires a person who is comfortable communicating at all levels of the organization, managing conflict and tradeoffs, and enabling cross-functional success. You are driven by problem solving, knowledge sharing, and leading teams to success through close collaboration.

Skills Required:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication to all levels of the organization with appropriate urgency. Understands team dynamics and acts as a liaison between cross-functional team members. Leads project meetings and leadership communications.
  • Demonstrates strong team building skills. Able to work with global, cross-functional, geographically dispersed teams to drive success in program execution. Able to coach team members for success.
  • Leads cross-functional teams using an iterative approach to product development. Partners effectively with software engineering to plan and deliver against requirements, architecture, implementation, verification/validation, release. Can scope, define, and manage to critical path including leading teams through program plan changes when needed.
  • Leads team to create and maintain an iterative development schedule and action plan (build-measure-learn cycles) that includes systems integration points and drives crucial conversations when necessary. Leads teams through identifying when countermeasures are needed and through countermeasure execution.
  • Defines program Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and understands how they impact the larger FHS-wide metrics. Can accurately track KPIs to support the high level KPIs in the organization.
  • Demonstrates strong software delivery expertise, including coordinating architecture decisions, test strategy, CI/CD considerations, and release planning for connected products.
  • Able to partner with data science and software engineering teams on development of AI-enabled features (e.g., workflow automation, decision-support, analytics), including defining success metrics, data needs, and validation approaches.
  • Owns tracking and communicating program risks – including collaborating on mitigation plans. Identifies when countermeasures are needed and leads trade off discussions/impact analysis to resolve.
  • Identifies when problem solving is needed, cultivates a culture of problem solving, and applies problem solving as a mindset to the program. Escalates problems to stakeholders when appropriate.
  • Experienced in change management and can commit, advocate, and lead through change.
  • Strong program management skills - including system tools and soft skills. Able to quickly incorporate Fortive Business System (FBS) tools - such as visual management - as applicable.
  • Create and maintain budgets for programs, including challenging unplanned spend. Communicates project spend forecasts to stakeholders and problem-solves budget challenges.
  • Strong knowledge of standard work around the entire product lifecycle to help develop durable, sustainable solutions.

  • Proficiency in English.

Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 10+ years of experience developing integrated solutions that include application software. Experience delivering production software releases is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with regulated industries is preferred.
  • Experience collaborating on AI/ML-enabled products or developing AI tools (e.g., LLM-powered assistants, automation, analytics) is a plus; familiarity with data governance and validation expectations in regulated environments is beneficial.
  • Demonstrated ability to inspire collaborative team execution, including leadership of geographically dispersed cross-functional development teams.
  • Proven experience in risk management and change management.
  • Comfortable communicating at all levels of the organization, adjusting appropriately for the audience and purpose.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution. A technical degree is a plus.
  • PMI/PMP certification is a plus.

Job Overview

As the Application Manager for Thailand and the Philippines, you will drive technical demand and funnel conversion by supporting high-touch (HT) sales opportunities across both markets. Acting as the technical bridge between customers, channel partners, and Fluke’s sales teams, you will apply deep product and application expertise to accelerate opportunities from qualification through to close. This role requires strong technical aptitude and excellent English communication skills, as you will support customers and partners across both the Thailand and Philippines markets

Primary Responsibilities / Duties

High-Touch Opportunity Support

  • Partner with the sales teams to identify, qualify, and advance high-touch (HT) opportunities across the Thailand and Philippines markets.

  • Provide on-site and remote technical support, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept trials to move opportunities through the sales funnel.

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for key customers and prospects throughout the evaluation and buying process.

  • Funnel Conversion & Sales Enablement

    • Drive funnel conversion by translating customer requirements into the right Fluke product and application solutions.

    • Collaborate with sales to track opportunity progression and remove technical barriers to close.

    • Support accurate forecasting by maintaining clear visibility of the technical status of active opportunities.

  • Technical & Application Expertise

    • Develop and maintain deep expertise across Fluke’s product portfolio and its application in customer environments.

    • Deliver product training, application seminars, and hands-on workshops to customers, channel partners, and internal sales teams.

    • Advise customers on best-fit solutions, measurement techniques, and relevant industry standards.

  • Channel & Customer Engagement

    • Build strong relationships with distributors, channel partners, and end users to expand Fluke’s technical footprint in both markets.

    • Gather and relay market intelligence, competitive insight, and voice-of-customer feedback to product marketing and management.

    • Represent Fluke at customer meetings, trade shows, and industry events across Thailand and the Philippines.

    Experience / Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a related technical discipline.

    • Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, technical sales support, or a customer-facing technical role, ideally within test & measurement or industrial products.

    • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand, demonstrate, and position complex products and applications.

    • Excellent English communication and presentation skills; Thai and/or Filipino language ability is an advantage given the two-market scope.

    • Proven ability to support sales opportunities and drive funnel conversion in a solutions-selling environment.

    • Willingness to travel across Thailand and the Philippines to support high-touch opportunities.

    • Self-motivated team player, able to operate effectively in a matrix, multi-market environment.
